roadmap.title: Urgent Diving achievements
roadmap.description: Use Dive to Location for the seven qualifying company Voyages before the Season 21 experiment temporarily removes Diving sometime in September 2026. The exact removal and return dates are not set.

roadmap.title: Onboarding, outposts, and account setup
roadmap.description: Finish the Maiden Voyage, visit every outpost, buy basic cosmetics and company licences, and clear simple sailing, cooking, and first-session achievements.

roadmap.title: Crew coordination and early multiplayer
roadmap.description: Bundle cooperative crew actions, cross-crew emotes and combat setups, first Captaincy tasks, and other short multiplayer requirements into planned sessions.

roadmap.title: Core Voyages, exploration, and collections
roadmap.description: Advance the main Trading Companies while completing repeatable Voyages, fishing, vaults, shrines, Sea Forts, Captaincy progress, and ordinary exploration counters.

roadmap.title: Tall Tales and story arcs
roadmap.description: Complete the Shores of Gold, Ashen Age, A Pirate's Life, and Monkey Island chains, collecting each Tale's journals and optional commendations before leaving its route.

roadmap.title: World events and advanced systems
roadmap.description: Clear Forts, fleets, Ashen Lords, the Burning Blade, Sunken Kingdom and Buried Treasure sets, Guild and Siren Song goals, weapon challenges, and current seasonal systems.

roadmap.title: Company mastery and endgame progression
roadmap.description: Finish high-level promotions, Athena's Fortune and Pirate Legend dependencies, advanced commendation metas, and remaining faction progression that is not purely cumulative.

roadmap.title: Long grinds, ledgers, PvP, and final cleanup
roadmap.description: Close monthly Emissary Ledgers, finish Hourglass and Guild commitments, complete large voyage, sale, distance, kill, ship, and RNG counters, then clean up any remaining meta-achievements.

achievements.description: A skeleton cronches through thick yellow peel. Attack it and kill it before it can heal!
achievements.summary: Kill a @enemy{skeleton} while it is eating a banana to heal.

guide.context: Skeletons visibly raise a banana during their healing animation; damage must finish the skeleton before that animation ends.

steps.text: Damage a skeleton, wait until it begins eating a banana, then kill the skeleton before it finishes healing.

achievements.description: A pirate may choose to go down with their ship. A musical send-off concludes their sad trip!
achievements.summary: Play any instrument while standing aboard your own ship as the ship sinks.

guide.context: Scuttling supplies a controlled setup, so no enemy crew is required.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{My Crew} in the pause menu and vote to scuttle your ship.
Remain aboard as the ship sinks, equip any musical instrument, and play until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: All on the Ferry are sister and brother. Send forth a message to someone or other!
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Pirate Chat} while another dead pirate is present on the @loc{Ferry of the Damned}.

guide.context: The other dead pirate may belong to your own crew; a rival crew is unnecessary.

steps.text: Die while at least one other player is also dead, then find that pirate aboard the Ferry of the Damned.
Open Pirate Chat and send any message while both pirates are on the Ferry.

achievements.description: Launched from your vessel, this cannon-fired trip must see you land safe on the deck of a ship!
achievements.summary: Fire yourself from a ship cannon and land safely on the deck of another ship.

guide.context: A player ship or Skeleton Ship qualifies, and arranging the attempt with another crew is the most reliable setup.

steps.text: Bring your ship alongside the target ship and aim one of your cannons at an open section of its deck.
Climb into the cannon, fire yourself, and land on the target ship's deck without falling into the sea.

achievements.description: You fought a crew, stood strong and brave and sent their ship to a watery grave!
achievements.summary: Contribute to sinking another crew's ship or a @enemy{Skeleton Ship}.

guide.context: The unlock credits participation in the sinking rather than requiring a solo sink.

steps.text: Attack another crew's ship or a Skeleton Ship with cannon fire until water damage sinks the vessel.
Remain in the encounter until the target ship fully disappears beneath the water.

achievements.description: You've overcome a score of tests and now you're hoarding twenty chests!
achievements.summary: Have your crew control a hoard of @item{20 chests} simultaneously.

guide.context: A Gold Hoarder Treasure Vault can provide many qualifying chests in one activity.

steps.text: Gather chests from voyages, world events, or a Treasure Vault without selling them.
Place the twentieth chest aboard your ship or otherwise under your crew's control while the previous nineteen remain possessed.

achievements.displayName: I'm On A Whole New Adventure
achievements.description: So many voyages, but which one to do? Stow yours and vote for one placed by your crew.
achievements.summary: Vote for and begin a voyage proposed by another member of your crew.

guide.context: Your own voyage does not qualify; another crewmate must put forward the voyage.

steps.text: Ask a crewmate to select a voyage at the ship's Quest Table and put it forward for a vote.
Cast your vote for that voyage and allow the crew vote to start it.

achievements.displayName: You Can Always Trust The Untrustworthy
achievements.description: Plundered from an unwary crew, their Captain's Chest cashed in - by you!
achievements.summary: Sell a @item{Captain's Chest} that was stolen from another crew.

guide.context: The chest must first belong to another crew; finding and selling your own Captain's Chest does not meet the stolen-loot condition.

steps.text: Board another crew's ship or recover its dropped loot and take a Captain's Chest that the other crew possessed.
Deliver the stolen Captain's Chest to a Gold Hoarder representative and sell it.

achievements.description: Commendations are given by Companies when you've reached certain targets. Try to earn ten!
achievements.summary: Unlock @mechanic{10 Commendations} across Sea of Thieves activities.

guide.context: Commendations are tracked in the Pirate Log under their associated companies and activity pages.

steps.text: Complete company, voyage, combat, or exploration requirements until ten commendations register in the Pirate Log.

achievements.description: When threatened at sword point, remember this trick: blind your poor foe with a bucket of sick!
achievements.summary: Throw a bucket of vomit onto a sword-holding pirate from another crew.

guide.context: A crewmate does not qualify. Eating bait such as worms, leeches, or grubs provides a quick way to induce vomiting.

steps.text: Eat bait until your pirate begins vomiting, hold a bucket during the vomiting animation, and collect the vomit.
Find a pirate from another crew who is holding a cutlass, equip the filled bucket, and throw the vomit onto that pirate.

achievements.description: Each new pirate greets the world with anchor raised and sails unfurled!
achievements.summary: Set sail on your first Sea of Thieves voyage session.

guide.context: This introductory achievement registers through normal first-session progression.

steps.text: Finish creating your pirate, enter a sailing session, and depart on your ship for the first time.

achievements.description: All sails with the wind, what time it saves when speeding across the ocean's waves!
achievements.summary: Sail with every sail fully angled into the wind so all sails reach full billow.

guide.context: A sail catches the wind when its cloth billows outward rather than hanging slack.

steps.text: While sailing, rotate every mast's sail angle until each sail catches the same wind direction and fully billows.

achievements.description: To swiftly avoid a great danger you're dreading, steer hard and drop anchor to alter your heading!
achievements.summary: Fully turn the ship's wheel left or right, then drop the anchor to perform a handbrake turn.

guide.context: The wheel must reach its steering limit before the anchor is dropped.

steps.text: Build forward speed and turn the ship's wheel completely to either side.
With the wheel still at full lock, lower the anchor and let the ship pivot.

achievements.description: A Company's pleased and you've reason to revel if your Reputation increased by one level!
achievements.summary: Increase your reputation by one level with any Trading Company.

guide.context: Selling suitable loot or completing company voyages awards the reputation needed for the first level.

steps.text: Complete a Trading Company activity or sell that company suitable loot until its reputation bar advances by one full level.

achievements.description: Your Voyages have earned you enough recognition so buy a Promotion and prove your position!
achievements.summary: Reach reputation level 5 with a Trading Company and purchase its first @mechanic{Promotion}.

guide.context: Promotions are purchased from the representative of the same company whose level requirement you met.

steps.text: Raise any Trading Company to reputation level 5.
Speak to that company's representative, open the Promotions option, and purchase the available level-5 promotion.

achievements.description: Two different crews, their tankards held high, will meet at a tavern and drain them all dry!
achievements.summary: Drink a full tankard of grog with a pirate from another crew inside an outpost tavern.

guide.context: Both pirates must be in the tavern and belong to different crews.

steps.text: Arrange to meet another crew inside any outpost tavern and have both pirates equip full tankards.
Raise the tankards together and drink the grog until your tankard is empty.

achievements.displayName: What Shall We Do with a Drunken Sailor?
achievements.description: Too many tankards of sweet, golden grog will first make you queasy, then sick as a dog…
achievements.summary: Drink grog until your pirate becomes drunk and starts vomiting.

guide.context: The tavern and ship both provide refillable grog barrels.

steps.text: Repeatedly fill and drain your tankard from a grog barrel until your pirate vomits.

achievements.description: A peg-leg, an eyepatch, a hat and a hook, all purchased to pull off the true pirate look!
achievements.summary: Purchase and equip a peg leg, eyepatch, hat, and hook from an outpost clothing shop.

guide.context: Any cosmetic variant of each of the four required clothing pieces qualifies.

steps.text: At an outpost clothing shop, purchase any peg leg, eyepatch, hat, and hook.
Open a Clothing Chest and equip all four purchased cosmetics at the same time.

achievements.description: Visit the Weaponsmith, you'll find they teach the value of buying a new Eye of Reach!
achievements.summary: Purchase any @item{Eye of Reach} cosmetic from an outpost Weaponsmith.

guide.context: The Eye of Reach is the game's sniper-rifle weapon category.

steps.text: Visit the Weaponsmith at any outpost, open the Eye of Reach stock, and purchase any available variant.

achievements.description: The Weaponsmith's open, you'll see it's no fuss to purchase a glorious new blunderbuss!
achievements.summary: Purchase any @item{Blunderbuss} cosmetic from an outpost Weaponsmith.

guide.context: Only a purchase is required; the weapon does not need to be equipped or fired.

steps.text: Visit the Weaponsmith at any outpost, open the Blunderbuss stock, and purchase any available variant.

achievements.description: Make your first buy from the Shipwright, who deals in figureheads, cannons, new sails and wheels!
achievements.summary: Purchase any ship cosmetic from the @npc{Shipwright} at an outpost.

guide.context: The Shipwright stands on the outpost dock near the Merchant Alliance and sells figureheads, cannons, sails, wheels, and other ship cosmetics.

steps.text: Speak to the Shipwright at any outpost, open the ship-cosmetic stock, and purchase one item.

achievements.description: Dexterous swordplay can keep you alive. Block an attack and then strike within five!
achievements.summary: Block an attack, then hit the attacker with your cutlass within five seconds.

guide.context: A member of your own crew can provide the attack, making this easy to stage safely.

steps.text: Hold the cutlass block, absorb another pirate's attack, then strike that pirate within five seconds of the block.

achievements.displayName: How Appropriate! You Fight Like A Chicken
achievements.description: Your trusty blade was just too slow. Now it's your turn to feel their blow!
achievements.summary: Have another pirate block your attack, then let that pirate hit you within five seconds.

guide.context: A member of your own crew can perform the counterattack.

steps.text: Swing your cutlass into another pirate's block, then allow that pirate to hit you within five seconds.

achievements.displayName: But You Have Heard Of Me?
achievements.description: Your reputation is starting to thrive. Grab your Promotion, you've reached twenty-five!
achievements.summary: Reach reputation level 25 with any Trading Company and purchase its level-25 Promotion.

guide.context: The promotion must be bought after reaching the threshold; reputation level alone does not complete the unlock.

steps.text: Raise one Trading Company to reputation level 25.
Speak to that company's representative and purchase the newly available level-25 promotion.

achievements.description: Titles are gathered from deeds near and far. Earn ten to show what type of pirate you are!
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{10 pirate titles} through promotions and commendations.

guide.context: Trading Company promotions award titles, so normal faction progression steadily fills this requirement.

steps.text: Purchase promotions and complete title-awarding commendations until ten distinct titles are registered to your pirate.

achievements.description: A Company's items are sold to the loyal, five upgrades rewards you with their finest spoil!
achievements.summary: Purchase all five successive item upgrades from one Trading Company through reputation level 45.

guide.context: A company offers its highest tier item at reputation level 45, after the earlier tiers have been purchased.

steps.text: Raise one Trading Company to reputation level 45.
From that company's representative, purchase the five successive versions of one company item through the highest tier.

achievements.description: A heavy attack while you've boarded their ship may send your foe over the side for a dip!
achievements.summary: Use a charged cutlass lunge to knock an enemy pirate off the deck of that pirate's ship.

guide.context: The target must be an opposing player aboard the opposing crew's vessel; friendly-crew targets do not satisfy the condition.

steps.text: Board another crew's ship and position an enemy pirate near an open deck edge.
Charge a cutlass heavy attack, hit the enemy pirate, and knock that pirate into the sea.

achievements.description: A true Pirate Legend is one of the greats and for them, Athena's Fortune awaits…
achievements.summary: Raise any three of @mechanic{Gold Hoarders, Merchant Alliance, Order of Souls, Reaper's Bones, or Hunter's Call} to reputation level 50, purchase each corresponding Promotion, and claim Pirate Legend from the Mysterious Stranger.

guide.context: Reaper's Bones and Hunter's Call count alongside the three original companies, so you can use whichever three reach reputation level 50 first.

steps.text: Raise three eligible Trading Companies to level 50 and purchase each company's level-50 promotion.
Visit the Mysterious Stranger inside any outpost tavern, speak to the Stranger after all three promotions are owned, and receive the Pirate Legend title.

achievements.description: To strike from behind is a sneaky attack that leads to a blunderbuss shot in the back!
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy pirate by shooting that pirate in the back with a @item{Blunderbuss}.

guide.context: The shot must be the killing blow and must strike from behind.

steps.text: Equip a Blunderbuss, move behind a pirate from another crew, and fire the killing shot into that pirate's back.

achievements.description: From under the waves a great creature arrived but you drove it away. Better still, you survived!
achievements.summary: Survive a @enemy{Kraken} attack and drive the creature away from your ship.

guide.context: A Kraken can attack a ship in open water when no world-event cloud is active; black water and tentacles signal the encounter.

steps.text: When the water turns black and Kraken tentacles surround your ship, damage the tentacles with cannons and firearms while repairing and bailing.
Continue defeating tentacles until the Kraken releases the ship and the water returns to normal.

achievements.description: Through stormy seas in silent flight, no lanterns lit to pierce the night.
achievements.estTime: 5 min at night in a storm
achievements.summary: At night, sail into a storm with every lantern on your ship extinguished.

guide.context: Every interior and exterior ship lantern counts, so check below deck as well as the deck and masts.

steps.text: At night, extinguish every lantern on your ship.
Keep all lanterns dark and sail into the storm until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: A greeting, when given with Pirate Salute, can make a new friend - or perhaps a recruit!
achievements.summary: Use the default @mechanic{Pirate Salute} or Make Friends Salute emote beside another pirate.

guide.context: The other pirate may belong to your crew, and the qualifying salute emote is unlocked by default.

steps.text: Stand near another pirate, open the emote wheel, and perform Pirate Salute or Make Friends Salute.

achievements.description: Just like Griffin, your pirate kin, 'cronch' a banana and eat its skin!
achievements.summary: Eat one @item{banana}.

guide.context: Bananas are common food supplies found in ship and island food barrels.

steps.text: Equip a banana from your food inventory and consume the entire fruit.

achievements.displayName: Legends - "The Greatest Race of All Time!"
achievements.description: Side by side, two ships must race with weapons silenced for first place!
achievements.summary: Race alongside another crew's ship in the same direction for several minutes without either crew firing weapons.

guide.context: The two ships may be allied, but weapon fire invalidates the peaceful race condition.

steps.text: Arrange with another crew to place both ships side by side on the same heading.
Maintain the parallel race for several minutes without either ship firing cannons or other weapons.

achievements.description: A chest of yours has gone astray and been cashed in as some thief's pay!
achievements.summary: Have another crew steal one of your chests and sell that chest.

guide.context: You can stage the requirement by giving a chest to a cooperative crew; the important condition is that the other crew completes the sale.

steps.text: Place one of your crew's chests where another crew can take possession of it.
Allow the other crew to deliver and sell the stolen chest while you remain in the session.

achievements.description: Five legends from across the sea playing instruments in harmony!
achievements.summary: Have five pirates play musical instruments together in synchronized harmony.

guide.context: The five musicians may come from any combination of crews.

steps.text: Gather five pirates in one location and have each pirate equip an instrument.
One pirate starts a shanty, then the other four join until all five are playing the same tune in harmony.

achievements.displayName: It's A Pirates Life For Me
achievements.description: The Voyage is done; a chest of old now safe with those who hoard their gold!
achievements.summary: Complete one @mechanic{Gold Hoarder Voyage} and finish its final objective.

guide.context: The voyage completes only when its last map, riddle, or other objective is resolved; selling the recovered chest is not required for this specific unlock.

steps.text: Choose a Gold Hoarder voyage at the ship's Quest Table and complete every objective shown on its quest maps.
Resolve the final objective and wait for the Voyage Complete banner.

achievements.description: You've gathered gold from near and far. A Master Hoarder now, you are!
achievements.summary: Reach Gold Hoarders reputation level 50 and purchase the level-50 @mechanic{Master Gold Hoarder Promotion}.

guide.context: Selling Gold Hoarder treasure and completing Gold Hoarder voyages raises the required reputation.

steps.text: Raise Gold Hoarders reputation to level 50.
Speak to a Gold Hoarder representative and purchase the level-50 Master Gold Hoarder promotion.

achievements.description: Your Voyage complete, a skull returned, praise from the Order thusly earned!
achievements.summary: Complete one @mechanic{Order of Souls Voyage} and finish its final bounty objective.

guide.context: A Short Crew Bounty is the quickest straightforward voyage option when available.

steps.text: Choose an Order of Souls bounty voyage at the ship's Quest Table and sail to the named island.
Defeat every required skeleton target until the Voyage Complete banner appears.

achievements.description: Sun-bleached skulls from across the ocean earn the Order's highest Promotion!
achievements.summary: Reach Order of Souls reputation level 50 and purchase the level-50 @mechanic{Master of the Order Promotion}.

guide.context: Order of Souls reputation comes primarily from selling bounty skulls and completing company voyages.

steps.text: Raise Order of Souls reputation to level 50.
Speak to an Order of Souls representative and purchase the level-50 Master of the Order promotion.

achievements.displayName: I Am Not Obsessed With Treasure
achievements.description: A Voyage is over, back to land a merchant's cargo in your hand!
achievements.summary: Complete one @mechanic{Merchant Alliance Voyage} and finish its required delivery or cargo objective.

guide.context: The voyage must reach its Voyage Complete state; merely picking up cargo is insufficient.

steps.text: Choose a Merchant Alliance voyage at the ship's Quest Table and collect the listed cargo, animals, or shipment clues.
Finish the voyage's required delivery or final objective and wait for the Voyage Complete banner.

achievements.description: The Merchant Alliance applauds your devotion bestowing upon you a Master Promotion!
achievements.summary: Reach Merchant Alliance reputation level 50 and purchase the level-50 @mechanic{Master Merchant Promotion}.

guide.context: Merchant Alliance voyages and sales of merchant cargo advance the company reputation.

steps.text: Raise Merchant Alliance reputation to level 50.
Speak to a Merchant Alliance representative and purchase the level-50 Master Merchant promotion.

achievements.description: Dig Up 250 chests whilst on Gold Hoarder X Marks the Spot Voyages.
achievements.estTime: 250 X Marks the Spot chest digs
achievements.summary: Dig up @mechanic{250 chests} while following Gold Hoarder X Marks the Spot Voyages.

guide.context: Only chest digs tied to X Marks the Spot voyages count; the requirement replaced the old voyage-purchase condition in January 2024.

steps.text: Start Gold Hoarder X Marks the Spot voyages, sail to each marked island, and dig at every red X.
Continue until 250 voyage-marked chests have been dug from the ground.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for completing 250 Gold Hoarder Voyages.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{250 Gold Hoarder Voyages} to finish the Golden Voyager Commendation.

guide.context: Short X Marks the Spot or riddle voyages minimize time, and progress is visible on the matching Gold Hoarder commendation.

steps.text: Repeatedly finish short Gold Hoarder voyages until the Golden Voyager Commendation reaches 250 completions.

achievements.description: Sail 1,000 nautical miles on Gold Hoarders Voyages, or with their Emissary Flag raised.
achievements.summary: Sail @mechanic{1,000 nautical miles} with a Gold Hoarder Voyage active or a Gold Hoarder Emissary Flag raised.

guide.context: Keeping the voyage or Emissary Flag active during unrelated sailing lets the distance counter advance passively.

steps.text: Start a Gold Hoarder voyage or raise the Gold Hoarder Emissary Flag before leaving an outpost.
Accumulate 1,000 nautical miles while one of those Gold Hoarder conditions remains active.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for selling 300 Shipwrecked Chests.
achievements.summary: Sell @mechanic{300 barnacled Shipwrecked Chests} to the Gold Hoarders.

guide.context: Shipwrecked Castaway, Seafarer's, Marauder's, and Captain's Chests have barnacles and qualify; they commonly come from shipwrecks, sunken Skeleton Ships, and underwater island loot.

steps.text: Recover barnacled Shipwrecked Chests from shipwrecks, Skeleton Ships, or underwater loot.
Sell 300 qualifying Shipwrecked Chests to Gold Hoarder representatives.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for earning 150,000 gold from Gold Hoarder voyages.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{150,000 gold} by selling treasure to the Gold Hoarders.

guide.context: A Gold Hoarder Emissary Flag increases sale value and accelerates the matching Keeper of a Glittering Hoard Commendation.

steps.text: Complete Gold Hoarder activities and sell treasure to Gold Hoarder representatives until the commendation records 150,000 gold.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for selling 360 Captain’s Chests.
achievements.summary: Turn in @mechanic{360 Captain's Chests} at Gold Hoarder tents.

guide.context: Normal and Ashen Captain's Chests both count; world events and raid voyages can supply them.

steps.text: Collect normal or Ashen Captain's Chests and sell 360 of them to Gold Hoarder representatives.

achievements.description: Correctly fill 250 animal crates whilst on Merchant Alliance Contract Voyages.
achievements.summary: Correctly place @mechanic{250 requested animals} into matching crates during Merchant Alliance Contract Voyages.

guide.context: Only animals captured for active Merchant Alliance animal contracts advance this changed January 2024 requirement.

steps.text: Start Merchant Alliance animal-contract voyages and collect the requested chicken, pig, or snake crates.
Find the listed animals and capture 250 of them in the matching crate types across any number of contracts.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for completing 250 Merchant Alliance Voyages.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{250 Merchant Alliance Voyages} to finish the Merchant Voyager Commendation.

guide.context: The matching commendation in the Merchant Alliance page tracks completed voyages.

steps.text: Repeatedly choose and finish short Merchant Alliance voyages until 250 completions register.

achievements.description: Sail 1,000 nautical miles on Merchant Alliance Voyages, or with their Emissary Flag raised.
achievements.summary: Sail @mechanic{1,000 nautical miles} with a Merchant Alliance Voyage active or a Merchant Alliance Emissary Flag raised.

guide.context: Leaving a Merchant Alliance condition active during ordinary sailing accumulates distance without dedicated routing.

steps.text: Start a Merchant Alliance voyage or raise the Merchant Alliance Emissary Flag.
Accumulate 1,000 nautical miles while the voyage or flag remains active.

achievements.description: Deliver 100 Gunpowder Barrels or Crates of Unprocessed Gunpowder.
achievements.summary: Fulfil Merchant Alliance delivery orders for @mechanic{100 total powder consignments}, using whichever item each order names: a Gunpowder Barrel or a Crate of Unprocessed Gunpowder, before the deadline.

guide.context: Bottle quests can request these deliveries; an ordinary keg without an active delivery order does not count.

steps.text: Search island beaches, shipwrecks, and floating debris for bottle quests that issue powder-delivery orders.
Use the requested items and deliver 100 total to each order's named recipient and outpost before its deadline.

achievements.description: Deliver 50 Fruit Crates or Crates of Unprepared Ingredients.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 timed Merchant Alliance orders that ask for a Fruit Crate or a Crate of Unprepared Ingredients.

guide.context: Use the delivery crate collected from the Merchant vendor—the separately purchased supply crate does not satisfy a delivery order.

steps.text: Collect bottle quests until one requests a Fruit Crate or Crate of Unprepared Ingredients, then pick up the marked delivery crate from the vendor.
Fill each delivery crate as required and deliver 50 total to the named recipients before the listed deadlines.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for earning 150,000 gold from Merchant Alliance Voyages.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{150,000 gold} from Merchant Alliance voyage cargo and sales.

guide.context: The Gilded Merchant Commendation on the Merchant Alliance page tracks qualifying gold.

steps.text: Complete Merchant Alliance voyages and sell merchant cargo until the Gilded Merchant Commendation records 150,000 gold.

achievements.description: Defeat 500 skeletons on an Order of Souls Bounty Voyage.
achievements.summary: Defeat @mechanic{500 skeletons} while an Order of Souls Bounty Voyage is active.

guide.context: The January 2024 requirement counts skeleton kills during bounty voyages rather than purchased voyages.

steps.text: Start an Order of Souls Bounty Voyage and travel to its target island.
Defeat skeletons while bounty voyages remain active until 500 qualifying kills register.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for completing 250 Order of Souls Voyages.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{250 Order of Souls Voyages} to finish the Voyager of Lost Souls Commendation.

guide.context: Short Crew or Captain bounty voyages provide the quickest repeated completions.

steps.text: Repeatedly finish short Order of Souls bounty voyages until 250 completions register.

achievements.description: Sail 1,000 nautical miles on Order of Souls Voyages, or with their Emissary Flag raised.
achievements.summary: Sail @mechanic{1,000 nautical miles} with an Order of Souls Voyage active or an Order of Souls Emissary Flag raised.

guide.context: Keeping a voyage or Emissary Flag active during other sailing turns routine travel into counter progress.

steps.text: Start an Order of Souls voyage or raise the Order of Souls Emissary Flag.
Accumulate 1,000 nautical miles while the voyage or flag remains active.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for defeating 1,000 Skeleton Captains.
achievements.summary: Defeat @mechanic{1,000 qualifying Skeleton Captains} from voyages or bottle quests.

guide.context: Emergent captains encountered randomly in the world do not count, but a crewmate's qualifying captain kill credits the whole crew.

steps.text: Run Order of Souls bounty voyages and captain-bearing bottle quests to generate qualifying Skeleton Captains.
Have your crew defeat 1,000 qualifying Skeleton Captains.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for earning 150,000 gold from Order of Souls Voyages.
achievements.summary: Accumulate @mechanic{150,000 gold} from Order of Souls sales of bounty skulls.

guide.context: The Mercenary of the Ancient Order Commendation on the company page tracks qualifying gold.

steps.text: Complete Order of Souls activities and sell bounty skulls to Order of Souls representatives until 150,000 gold registers.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for selling 360 Villainous Skulls.
achievements.summary: Turn in @mechanic{360 Villainous Bounty Skulls} through Order of Souls representatives.

guide.context: Normal and Ashen Villainous Bounty Skulls both count, and world events or raid voyages can supply them.

steps.text: Collect normal or Ashen Villainous Bounty Skulls and sell 360 to Order of Souls representatives.

achievements.description: A midnight snack, if you desire, cooked to perfection on a fire!
achievements.summary: Cook any food to perfection on an island campfire at night.

guide.context: The cooking station must be an island campfire rather than the stove aboard a ship.

steps.text: After nightfall, find an island campfire, add wood if needed, and light it with your lantern.
Place any raw food on the campfire pan and remove it when fully cooked but before it burns.

achievements.description: Your hearty meal's turned out wrong.  You left it on the stove too long!
achievements.summary: Leave any food on a stove or campfire until the food burns.

guide.context: Either a ship stove or an island campfire qualifies.

steps.text: Place food on a lit stove or campfire and leave it cooking past the cooked stage until it becomes burnt.

achievements.description: Well-cooked meals are never easy,  dine too soon and you'll get queasy!
achievements.summary: Eat raw meat or raw fish until your pirate becomes sick.

guide.context: Uncooked animal food causes vomiting after consumption; fruit does not qualify.

steps.text: Catch fish or obtain meat, leave it uncooked, then eat raw pieces until your pirate vomits.

achievements.description: Sampling every type of fruit  will keep you fit to fight and loot!
achievements.summary: Eat one banana, coconut, pomegranate, mango, and pineapple.

guide.context: The five fruit types can be consumed across normal exploration; they do not need to be eaten in one sitting.

steps.text: Find food barrels and consume at least one @item{banana}, @item{coconut}, @item{pomegranate}, @item{mango}, and @item{pineapple}.

achievements.description: Ill-gotten gains - yet, after all,  they still sold to the Hunter's Call.
achievements.summary: Sell one piece of @item{Treacherous Plunder} to the Hunter's Call.

guide.context: Old Boots, Old Hats, Fish Bones, and Old Skulls qualify; these rare objects are hooked while fishing without bait.

steps.text: Cast a fishing line without bait and keep recasting until you hook an Old Boot, Old Hat, Fish Bones, or Old Skull instead of a fish.
Deliver the Treacherous Plunder item to a Hunter's Call representative or a Sovereign and sell it.

achievements.description: Little fishie, all aglow,  off to The Hunter's Call you go.
achievements.estTime: catch and sell one night fish
achievements.summary: After dark, catch a glowing @item{Seafoam Splashtail} with an unbaited line in open water and sell it to the Hunter's Call.

guide.context: Seafoam Splashtail is the night variant of the everywhere-spawning Splashtail family, so it avoids regional and bait requirements.

steps.text: After nightfall, cast an unbaited fishing line into open seawater and reel in a glowing Seafoam Splashtail.
Sell the Seafoam Splashtail to a Hunter's Call representative or a Sovereign.

achievements.description: If reeling a coloured fish in, take care,  The Hunter's Call claim they're incredibly rare!
achievements.estTime: catch and sell one rare fish
achievements.summary: Catch a rare @item{Umber Splashtail} with an unbaited line in open water and sell it to the Hunter's Call.

guide.context: Umber Splashtail is a rare variant of the most common fish family; Splashtails spawn in most open bodies of seawater and require no bait.

steps.text: Cast an unbaited fishing line into open seawater, cancel ordinary catches, and reel in Umber Splashtail when it appears.
Sell the Umber Splashtail to a Hunter's Call representative or a Sovereign.

achievements.description: A feast of meats all roasted well, each kind to The Hunter's Call you'll sell.
achievements.estTime: cook and sell six meat types
achievements.summary: Cook one piece each of chicken, pork, snake, shark, Megalodon, and Kraken meat, then sell all six cooked meats to the Hunter's Call.

guide.context: Each meat type has its own Grade 1 Hunter's Call commendation; cooking must finish before sale.

steps.text: Obtain chicken, pork, snake, shark, Megalodon, and Kraken meat.
Cook one piece of each meat until fully done without burning it.
Sell all six cooked meat types to Hunter's Call representatives or Sovereigns.

achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for delivering 25 Trophy Fish to The Hunter's Call.
achievements.summary: Turn in @mechanic{25 Trophy Fish} through Hunter's Call representatives.

guide.context: Trophy Fish are visibly larger than standard fish and take longer to reel in; the matching commendation tracks the total.

steps.text: Fish in any valid fishing area and reel in the larger Trophy variant whenever one bites.
Sell 25 Trophy Fish to Hunter's Call representatives or Sovereigns.

achievements.description: A platter of each kind of fish will serve the Hunters quite a dish!
achievements.summary: Sell at least one of every fish variety required for all Grade 1 Hunter's Call fish commendations.

guide.context: The requirement spans every regular, rare, and night color variant across all ten fish families; the Hunter's Call commendation page preserves the checklist.

steps.text: Without bait, catch every Splashtail variant in open seawater, every Pondie variant in freshwater ponds, and every Islehopper variant beside its listed large islands.

With Earthworms, catch every Plentifin variant in The Shores of Plenty, every Wildsplash variant in The Wilds, and every Wrecker variant beside shipwrecks; catch Blackcloud Wrecker while the wreck is inside a storm.
With Leeches, catch every Ancientscale variant in The Ancient Isles and every Stormfish variant inside heavy storms, changing regions for the regional Stormfish.
With Grubs, catch every Devilfish variant in The Devil's Roar and every Battlegill variant near Skeleton Ships or active Skeleton Fort-family events.
Sell every caught fish variety to Hunter's Call representatives or Sovereigns until every fish-family commendation reaches Grade 1.

achievements.displayName: Legendary Hunter of the Sea of Thieves
achievements.description: Receive the Commendation for completing 57 Grade 5 Hunter's Call Commendations.
achievements.summary: Complete any @mechanic{57 Grade 5 Hunter's Call Commendations} to unlock the Legendary Hunter title.

guide.context: Season 15 added further Hunter's Call activities, but the achievement still uses the broad 57-commendation threshold; the Pirate Log shows every eligible graded commendation and its exact counter.

steps.text: Open Pirate Log, Reputation, Hunter's Call, and identify graded commendations that are nearest to Grade 5.
Complete fish, cooking, Treacherous Plunder, voyage, hunt, or other Hunter's Call requirements until any 57 eligible commendations reach Grade 5.
Open the Hunter's Call page and verify that @mechanic{Legendary Hunter of the Sea of Thieves} and its title are both awarded.

achievements.description: Purchase the Master Hunter Promotion from The Hunter's Call Trading Company.
achievements.summary: Reach Hunter's Call reputation level 50 and purchase the @mechanic{Master Hunter Promotion}.

guide.context: Fish, cooked meat, Treacherous Plunder, and Mermaid Gems can raise Hunter's Call reputation; Larinna can also sell one reputation level per month for Doubloons.

steps.text: Sell qualifying fish, meat, Treacherous Plunder, and Mermaid Gems until Hunter's Call reaches reputation level 50.
Speak to a Hunter's Call representative and purchase the Master Hunter promotion.

achievements.description: A sunken ship and ancient key will set you on a great journey!
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Shroudbreaker} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: The Shroudbreaker opens the Shores of Gold arc and can be selected from the ship's Quest Table or voted on beside the Mysterious Stranger in an outpost tavern.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose @mechanic{Tall Tales}, @mechanic{Shores of Gold}, then @mechanic{The Shroudbreaker}, and vote to begin.
Use the Tale Book's changing clues to recover the Ancient Vault medallions and Shroudbreaker, then return the Shroudbreaker to the Mysterious Stranger to complete the tale.

achievements.description: A Cursed Rogue searching, never sleeping. What great secrets is she keeping?
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Cursed Rogue} Tall Tale once after finishing The Shroudbreaker.

guide.context: The tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on beside Madame Olivia at Plunder Outpost; its island clues vary between runs.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then The Cursed Rogue, and vote to begin.
Follow the Tale Book to recover Briggsy's artefacts, use Madame Olivia's Enchanted Compass to find and defeat Briggsy, then return Briggsy's Skull to Madame Olivia.

achievements.description: Adventures told with a fearless grin. Perhaps some truths might lie within?
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Legendary Storyteller} Tall Tale once after finishing The Cursed Rogue.

guide.context: The tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on at Tasha's bar counter in the Ancient Spire Outpost tavern.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then The Legendary Storyteller, and vote to begin.
Solve the locations in Briggsy's stories, recover the keys and Ancient Crown, then return the Ancient Crown to Tasha.

achievements.description: The heavens' secrets, now concealed through ancient fable are revealed!
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Stars of a Thief} Tall Tale once after finishing The Cursed Rogue.

guide.context: The tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on at Sudds' desk at The North Star Seapost.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then Stars of a Thief, and vote to begin.
Use the Star Map and Tale Book to locate both Star Jewels, solve the Ancient Vault, and return the recovered Shroudbreaker Stone to Sudds.

achievements.description: Jealous wrongs must be set right so two young lovers can unite!
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Wild Rose} Tall Tale once after finishing The Cursed Rogue.

guide.context: The tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on beside Madame Olive at Sanctuary Outpost.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then Wild Rose, and vote to begin.
Use the Tale Book to recover Rose's and George's keepsakes, follow the Enchanted Compass to both pendant halves, and return the pendants to Madame Olive.

achievements.description: A shining treasure you must claim, the prize within a deadly game!
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Art of the Trickster} Tall Tale once after finishing The Cursed Rogue.

guide.context: The tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on beside Salty at the east-beach shipwreck on Plunder Valley; the Gunpowder Key explodes if damaged.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then The Art of the Trickster, and vote to begin.
Solve the Trapmaker's clues, carry the Gunpowder Key through Sailor's Bounty without detonating it, clear the final chamber, and return the Shroudbreaker Stone to Salty.

achievements.description: Guide three wayward souls to rest, the next step on your golden quest!
achievements.summary: Finish one run of @mechanic{The Fate of the Morningstar} after unlocking it by clearing the four Briggsy routes.

guide.context: Start this Tall Tale from the ship's Quest Table; its in-world Tale Book sits on the @loc{Ferry of the Damned}, beside @npc{the Ferryman}.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then The Fate of the Morningstar, and vote to begin.
Use the Enchanted Lantern and Tale Book to locate and release the three Morningstar crew souls, then return to the Ferryman.

achievements.description: Great evil sleeps below the sands, revenge at last within your hands!
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Revenge of the Morningstar} Tall Tale once after finishing The Fate of the Morningstar.

guide.context: The tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on beside Sandra at Dagger Tooth Outpost.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then Revenge of the Morningstar, and vote to begin.
Recover the Morningstar uniforms and passwords, defeat Graymarrow to obtain the Shroudbreaker Stone, and return the stone to Sandra.

achievements.description: Forbidden secrets must be told. What lies beneath the Shores of Gold?
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Shores of Gold} Tall Tale once after finishing Revenge of the Morningstar.

guide.context: The final tale can be selected at the Quest Table or voted on beside Grace Morrow at Morrow's Peak Outpost; the completed Shroudbreaker allows passage through the Devil's Shroud to Tribute Peak.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, then The Shores of Gold, and vote to begin.
Collect the Shroudbreaker from Grace Morrow, mount it on your ship, and follow the Tale Book chart through the Devil's Shroud to Tribute Peak.
Solve the four vaults, pass the Belly of Gold traps, defeat the Gold Hoarder, and remain through the tale's completion sequence.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for 'The Shroudbreaker' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete The Shroudbreaker five times and read all five @item{Mercia's Journals} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: The journals persist after being read, while the five-completion counter advances only when the tale reaches its completion banner.

steps.text: Complete The Shroudbreaker five times.

Read Mercia's Journals at uncharted island N-13 between three beach rocks; the Ancient Spire Outpost upper cave; the camp by Devil's Ridge's northern cannon; the central overgrown shack on Thieves' Haven; and the Plunder Outpost campfire.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every The Shroudbreaker commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for 'The Cursed Rogue' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete The Cursed Rogue five times and read all five @item{Bounty Hunter's Journals} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: Journal credit is permanent, so collect each journal once and use later runs only for the five-completion requirement.

steps.text: Complete The Cursed Rogue five times.

Read the Bounty Hunter's Journals in Shark Bait Cove's south tunnel; by the northeast rowboat wreck on Discovery Ridge; at the southeast skull pile on Kraken's Fall; in the hilltop-ruin wall on Wanderer's Refuge; and in the cave across from the Crook's Hollow docks.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every The Cursed Rogue commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for 'The Legendary Storyteller' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete The Legendary Storyteller five times and read all five @item{Briggsy's Journals} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: The five journals need to be read only once each; the tale itself must still be completed five times.

steps.text: Complete The Legendary Storyteller five times.

Read Briggsy's Journals in Lone Cove's northwest cave; at Mermaid's Hideaway's northwest campfire; in the Old Salts Atoll shipwreck; inside the Dagger Tooth Outpost tavern; and in the cage at Galleon's Grave Outpost.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every The Legendary Storyteller commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for the 'Stars of a Thief' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete Stars of a Thief five times and read all five @item{Sudds' Notes} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: Journal credit persists separately from the tale's five-completion counter.

steps.text: Complete Stars of a Thief five times.
Read Sudds' Notes on Rum Runner Isle's east islet; at Plunder Valley's highest peak; on Snake Island's mainland; by Devil's Ridge's northeast rock; and among Crescent Isle's southwest rocks.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every Stars of a Thief commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for the 'Wild Rose' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete Wild Rose five times and read all five @item{Lovers' Notes} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: The notes persist once read, allowing the remaining runs to focus on fast tale completion.

steps.text: Complete Wild Rose five times.
Read the Lovers' Notes on Rapier Cay; at Cannon Cove's bay campfire; by Lone Cove's central rock; on the east side of Lagoon of Whispers; and on Sailor's Bounty's northeast islet.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every Wild Rose commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for 'The Art of the Trickster' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete The Art of the Trickster five times and read all five @item{Trapmaker's Journals} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: A checkpoint before the Gunpowder Key can be restarted if the key is destroyed, and restarting can reroll puzzle variants.

steps.text: Complete The Art of the Trickster five times.
Read the Trapmaker's Journals in Plunder Valley's bird cave; above the ridge on Discovery Ridge; under the counter in the Trapmaker's Lair; on the Lair's anvil; and at the foot of the Lair's bed.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every The Art of the Trickster commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for 'The Fate of the Morningstar' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete The Fate of the Morningstar five times and read all five @item{Ghost Hunter's Journals} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: All five journals are on Old Faithful Isle, so collect them together during a run that sends the tale there.

steps.text: Complete The Fate of the Morningstar five times.
Read the Ghost Hunter's Journals at Old Faithful Isle's south white flagpost; highest peak; west-ridge Kraken remains; southwest skull pile; and platform above the east tunnel.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every The Fate of the Morningstar commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for 'The Revenge of the Morningstar' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: Complete Revenge of the Morningstar five times and read all five @item{Eli Slate's Journals} to earn every tale commendation.

guide.context: Each journal needs one read, while Revenge of the Morningstar must reach completion five separate times.

steps.text: Complete Revenge of the Morningstar five times.

Read Eli Slate's Journals by the western crate on Boulder Cay; in the Sanctuary Outpost tavern; beside barrels on Cannon Cove's highest south cliff; on The Sunken Grove's northeast islet; and by Marauder's Arch's high west cannon.
Open the Pirate Log and confirm every Revenge of the Morningstar commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Receive all Commendations for all the Shores of Gold Tall Tales.
achievements.summary: Earn every commendation across all nine @mechanic{Shores of Gold Tall Tales}.

guide.context: This meta-achievement requires the full commendation pages for The Shroudbreaker through The Shores of Gold, including five completions and journal sets for every tale.

steps.text: Finish every commendation in @mechanic{The Shroudbreaker} and @mechanic{The Cursed Rogue}; then clear the full sets for @mechanic{The Legendary Storyteller} and @mechanic{Stars of a Thief}. Next, complete @mechanic{Wild Rose} and @mechanic{The Art of the Trickster} in full. Do the same for @mechanic{The Fate of the Morningstar} and @mechanic{Revenge of the Morningstar}.
Complete The Shores of Gold five times and read all ten Briggsy journals throughout Tribute Peak.
Open Pirate Log, Tall Tales, Shores of Gold, and confirm every commendation in all nine tale pages is complete.

achievements.description: That shark bit off more than it could chew, when it chose to mess with you.
achievements.summary: Kill a @enemy{shark} with the explosion from a Gunpowder Barrel.

guide.context: Sharks have increased spawn chances near naval combat and shipwrecks; the barrel explosion must deliver the killing damage.

steps.text: Carry a Gunpowder Barrel into the water near a shipwreck or naval encounter and wait for a shark to approach.
When the shark charges close to the barrel, ignite the barrel from a safe distance and ensure the explosion kills the shark.

achievements.description: Defeat each colour of Shadow of Fate.
achievements.estTime: one Fort of the Damned run
achievements.summary: Defeat one Shadow of Fate skeleton in each of the six flame colors during Fort of the Damned encounters.

guide.context: A Shadow is invulnerable until raised lantern light of the matching color exposes it; your crew's kills count, but an alliance crew's kills do not.

steps.text: During Fort of the Damned waves, raise the matching Blue, Red, Green, White, Purple, or Pink Flame of Fate lantern near each colored Shadow.
Have your own crew defeat at least one exposed Shadow of Fate in every one of the six colors.

achievements.description: Activate the Fort of the Damned by lighting all six Flames of Fate and sacrificing a Ritual Skull.
achievements.summary: Activate the @loc{Fort of the Damned} by lighting all six Flame of Fate statues and placing a Ritual Skull on the central skeleton.

guide.context: A Skull of Destiny can supply all six flames and also function as the Ritual Skull; the traditional method stores six death-earned flames in ship lanterns.

steps.text: Obtain Blue from a shark or Megalodon death, Red from fire or lava, Green from a skeleton, White from lightning, Purple from snake poison, and Pink from a non-allied player, then collect each flame from the Well of Fates on the Ferry.
Obtain a Ritual Skull from an Ashen Chest or Skeleton Fleet, or bring a Skull of Destiny instead.
At the Fort of the Damned tower, light the six statues with their matching flames and place the Ritual Skull or Skull of Destiny on the seated skeleton.

achievements.description: Clear the Fort of the Damned of all enemies.
achievements.summary: Clear every enemy wave and defeat the final boss at the @loc{Fort of the Damned} once.

guide.context: You receive completion credit even if another crew activated the event.

steps.text: Join an active Fort of the Damned, use matching Flames of Fate to expose each Shadow wave, and defeat every enemy.
Defeat the Ghost of Graymarrow final boss and remain until the fort-completion banner appears.

achievements.description: Clear the Fort of the Damned of all enemies, 10 times.
achievements.estTime: ten Fort of the Damned clears
achievements.summary: Clear every enemy wave and final boss at the @loc{Fort of the Damned} ten times.

guide.context: After one clear, extra Ritual Skulls allow the fort to be restarted without collecting the six flames again; the Banishing the Damned Commendation tracks clears.

steps.text: Complete the Fort of the Damned ten times by defeating all Shadow waves and the Ghost of Graymarrow on each run.

achievements.description: Complete The Seabound Soul
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Seabound Soul} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: The tale can be selected from the Quest Table or voted on at the ritual table inside the Blackwyche wreck on Shipwreck Bay.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, choose Tall Tales, Ashen Age, then The Seabound Soul, and vote to begin.
Use Pendragon's Enchanted Lantern and the Tale Book to trace the lost ships, recover each captain's skull, and let Pendragon release the three trapped souls.

achievements.description: Complete all commendations for The Seabound Soul
achievements.estTime: three completions, five journals, three artefacts
achievements.summary: Complete The Seabound Soul three times, read all five Ashen Dragon Journals, and recover the Ashen Artefacts at @loc{Tri-Rock Isle, Cursewater Shores, and Cinder Islet}.

guide.context: The lantern reveals the buried artefact clues; journal and artefact commendations persist, while the tale-completion counter requires three finished runs.

steps.text: Complete The Seabound Soul three times.

Read the journals in the Blackwyche captain's quarters on Shipwreck Bay; between central rocks on Shiver Retreat; among dead-tree roots on Liar's Backbone; by the eastern rock on Scorched Pass; and near the northeast beacon on Flintlock Peninsula.
Use the Enchanted Lantern to find and dig up the Ashen Artefacts on Tri-Rock Isle, Cursewater Shores, and Cinder Islet.
Open The Seabound Soul page in the Pirate Log and confirm every commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Sell the Tome of Curses I.
achievements.summary: Open Ashen Chests until you find @item{Tome of Curses I}, then sell that exact tome to Larinna or the Reaper's Bones.

guide.context: Ashen Chests require Ashen Keys and contain random tomes; both items can come from Skeleton Forts, Skeleton Ships, and Ashen Guardians, and tomes do not spawn in Safer Seas.

steps.text: In High Seas, obtain an Ashen Chest and Ashen Key, unlock the chest, and repeat until Tome of Curses I appears.
Carry Tome of Curses I to Larinna outside any outpost tavern or to the Reaper's Bones at Reaper's Hideout and sell it.

achievements.description: Sell the Tome of Curses II.
achievements.summary: Open locked @item{Ashen Chests} until you find @item{Tome of Curses II}, then sell that tome to @npc{Larinna} or @npc{The Servant of the Flame}.

guide.context: Ashen Tome contents are random. A locked @item{Ashen Chest} guarantees one tome, while already-open chests from some encounters do not guarantee one.

steps.text: Acquire a locked @item{Ashen Chest} and an @item{Ashen Key}; Skeleton Forts and emergent Ashen Guardians or Ashen Key Masters can provide them.
Unlock the chest and keep opening additional locked Ashen Chests until @item{Tome of Curses II} appears.
Complete the sale with @npc{Larinna}, who stands outside an Outpost tavern. Alternatively, at @loc{The Reaper's Hideout}, trade the tome to @npc{The Servant of the Flame}.

steps.text: Acquire a locked @item{Ashen Chest} and an @item{Ashen Key}; Skeleton Forts and emergent Ashen Guardians or Ashen Key Masters can provide them.
Unlock the chest and keep opening additional locked Ashen Chests until @item{Tome of Curses V} appears.
Complete the sale with @npc{Larinna}, who stands outside an Outpost tavern. Alternatively, at @loc{The Reaper's Hideout}, trade the tome to @npc{The Servant of the Flame}.

achievements.description: Sell all 5 Tomes of Curses.
achievements.summary: Sell all five distinct @item{Tomes of Curses} at least once.

guide.context: Each locked @item{Ashen Chest} guarantees one random Ashen Tome when opened with an @item{Ashen Key}; duplicate volumes do not advance the five-volume set.

steps.text: Open locked @item{Ashen Chests} with @item{Ashen Keys} and collect Tome of Curses I, II, III, IV, and V.
Register one sale for each of the five volumes. Use @npc{Larinna} outside an Outpost tavern, or take them to @loc{The Reaper's Hideout} and trade with @npc{The Servant of the Flame}.

achievements.summary: Open locked @item{Ashen Chests} until you find @item{Tome of Power I}, then sell that tome to @npc{Larinna} or @npc{The Servant of the Flame}.

achievements.description: Complete Heart of Fire
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Heart of Fire} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: Start the Tall Tale from Tallulah at The Charred Parrot on Morrow's Peak Outpost after completing The Seabound Soul.

steps.text: Vote on the @mechanic{Heart of Fire} Tall Tale beside @npc{Tallulah} at @loc{The Charred Parrot} on @loc{Morrow's Peak Outpost}.
Follow Grace Morrow's journal to Liar's Backbone, solve the glyph clue, then enter Flameheart's Lair below The Devil's Thirst.
Complete any one of the three trap routes, defeat the final skeleton waves, and return the Chest of Rage to @npc{Pendragon}.

achievements.description: Complete all commendations for Heart of Fire
achievements.summary: Complete every @mechanic{Heart of Fire} commendation: three runs, five journals, and the @mechanic{Path of the Eternal King, Path of the Forsaken Flame, and Path of the Burning Heart}.

guide.context: The three trap-path commendations grant crew-wide credit when one crewmate finishes a path. The journals are split between Liar's Backbone, the central chamber, and one journal in each route.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Heart of Fire} three times and finish the Path of the Eternal King, Path of the Forsaken Flame, and Path of the Burning Heart.
Read Stitcher Jim's journal on the shelf in his @loc{Liar's Backbone} lair and the journal beside the middle doorway in Flameheart's Lair.
Read the route journal in each of the blue, green, and red paths; use a Mermaid Statue or a new run to return for routes your crew did not traverse.
Finish the remaining Heart of Fire commendations shown in Pirate Log > Reputation > Tall Tales.

achievements.description: Find and sell at least one of each Legendary Treasure.

guide.context: Legend of the Veil loot is not part of this original seven-item set. Athena's Fortune Voyages provide the required treasures.

steps.text: Become a Pirate Legend and obtain Athena's Fortune Voyages.

Make seven separate Legendary Treasure sales: one @item{Chest of Legends}; one @item{Chalice of Ancient Fortune}; one @item{Gilded Relic of Ancient Fortune}; one @item{Skull of Ancient Fortune}; one @item{Villainous Skull of Ancient Fortune}; one @item{Crate of Legendary Voyages}; and one @item{Keg of Ancient Black Powder}.
Deliver each required item to the @npc{Mysterious Stranger} in an Outpost tavern.

achievements.description: Defeat the ghost of the Burning Blade 10 times!
achievements.summary: Destroy @enemy{The Burning Blade} ghost ship ten times.

guide.context: The qualifying ship appears as the final boss of eligible Order of Souls Ghost Fleet encounters or the matching world event; the Order of Souls quest variant requires reputation level 75.

steps.text: Start an eligible Order of Souls Ghost Fleet encounter or sail to the Burning Blade ghost-fleet world event.
Destroy the preliminary ghost-ship waves, then fire cannonballs or Wraith Cannonballs into @enemy{The Burning Blade} until it sinks.
Repeat until the Order of Souls commendation records ten Burning Blade defeats.

achievements.description: Defeat 500 ghost ships!

guide.context: Order of Souls Ghost Fleet Voyages, the Burning Blade ghost-fleet event, and the final Legend of the Veil chapter all provide qualifying targets.

steps.text: Start Order of Souls Ghost Fleet Voyages, Burning Blade ghost-fleet events, or Legend of the Veil finales.
Use ship cannons to destroy grunt and captain @enemy{Ghost Ships}; grunt ships normally require three hits.
Continue until the Order of Souls commendation reaches 500 destroyed Ghost Ships.

Fight @enemy{Captain Grimm} through all phases and land enough damage for crew credit when the Ashen Lord is defeated.
Repeat encounters until the Bilge Rats > Ashen Winds commendation records five defeats of @enemy{Captain Grimm}.
