achievements.description: Defeat Warden Chi 5 times
achievements.summary: Defeat the Ashen Lord @enemy{Warden Chi} five times.

guide.context: Ashen Lords are randomly selected for Ashen Winds encounters, so progress for a particular named lord depends on which boss appears.

steps.text: Sail to or dive to an active @mechanic{Ashen Winds} encounter.
Fight @enemy{Warden Chi} through all phases and land enough damage for crew credit when the Ashen Lord is defeated.
Repeat encounters until the Bilge Rats > Ashen Winds commendation records five defeats of @enemy{Warden Chi}.

achievements.description: Find a Vault Key using only 1 piece of Torn Map Parchment.
achievements.summary: Dig up a @item{Treasure Vault Key} after collecting only the first Torn Map Parchment on a Wayfinder Voyage.

guide.context: This is luck-dependent: the first parchment must reveal enough of the island and the X for you to identify the dig site. Wayfinder Voyages require Gold Hoarders reputation level 25.

steps.text: Reach Gold Hoarders reputation level 25 and start a Wayfinder Voyage.
Use the Golden Wayfinder to recover exactly one Torn Map Parchment.
If the first parchment shows the X and enough coastline to identify the island, sail there without collecting another parchment and dig at the marked position.
Recover the @item{Treasure Vault Key} while the voyage still shows only one parchment collected.

achievements.description: Open three Treasure Vaults with gold vault keys.
achievements.summary: Use @item{Gold Treasure Vault Keys} to open three Treasure Vaults.

guide.context: The voyage owner's Gold Hoarders reputation determines the Treasure Vault Key tier; Gold keys enter the Wayfinder Voyage reward pool at reputation level 45.

steps.text: Reach Gold Hoarders reputation level 45 and complete Wayfinder Voyages until you recover a @item{Gold Treasure Vault Key}.
Read the island and vault name engraved on the key, sail to that island, and place the key in the matching vault lock.
Repeat with three Gold Treasure Vault Keys; opening the door supplies the credit.

achievements.description: Pick up all the mounds of gold inside a Treasure Vault.
achievements.summary: Pick up every loose gold mound inside one opened @loc{Treasure Vault} before the chamber is exhausted.

guide.context: Loose gold mounds are the only requirement; solving the medallion puzzle and removing every chest are unnecessary. A Stone vault has fewer mounds and is the easiest tier.

steps.text: Open a Stone-tier or other @loc{Treasure Vault} with its matching key.
Immediately collect every sparkling loose gold mound from the floor, shelves, and ledges before prioritising treasure chests.
Keep collecting after the door closes if necessary, using food to delay drowning, until the final gold mound is picked up.

achievements.description: Locate the missing ship on a Lost Shipment Voyage without finding all the clues.
achievements.summary: Find a Lost Shipment shipwreck before discovering every clue, then take its @item{Merchant Manifest}.

guide.context: Lost Shipment Voyages require Merchant Alliance reputation level 25. Taking the manifest completes the voyage and despawns remaining clue sites, so only pick it up after you have found the wreck.

steps.text: Reach Merchant Alliance reputation level 25 and begin a Lost Shipment Voyage.
Follow the Trade Route Map but deliberately skip at least one clue while searching the route and nearby deviations for the shipwreck.
Board the wreck, locate the skeleton captain, and pick up the @item{Merchant Manifest} before all clues have been found.

achievements.description: On Lost Shipment Voyages, locate a missing ship along each of the Merchants' trade routes.
achievements.summary: Locate the missing ship on all 13 distinct @mechanic{Lost Shipment Trade Routes}.

guide.context: Route direction does not matter, route selection depends partly on where the voyage is started, and the game does not provide a completed-route checklist.

steps.text: Complete Lost Shipment Voyages on these routes: Sanctuary Outpost–The Wild Treasure Store, Sanctuary Outpost–Galleon's Grave Outpost, Port Merrick–Smugglers Bay, Port Merrick–Dagger Tooth Outpost, and Port Merrick–The Finest Trading Post.

Complete Dagger Tooth Outpost–Marauder's Arch, Galleon's Grave Outpost–Ancient Spire Outpost, Galleon's Grave Outpost–Morrow's Peak Outpost, Plunder Outpost–Morrow's Peak Outpost, and Ancient Spire Outpost–The Finest Trading Post.
Complete The Finest Trading Post–Devil's Ridge, Morrow's Peak Outpost–Ashen Reaches, and Brian's Bazaar–Roaring Traders.
On every route, find the wreck and recover its @item{Merchant Manifest}; keep an external checklist because voyage direction is interchangeable and in-game route tracking is absent.

achievements.description: Recover 5 Revered Manifests while on Lost Shipment Voyages.
achievements.summary: Recover five @item{Revered Merchant Manifests} during Lost Shipment Voyages.

guide.context: Lost Shipment Voyages unlock at Merchant Alliance level 25, but Revered-quality manifests require Merchant Alliance reputation level 50 or higher. Selling the manifest is not required.

steps.text: Reach Merchant Alliance reputation level 50 and start a Lost Shipment Voyage.
Follow the trade route to the missing ship, locate the captain's skeleton, and pick up the @item{Revered Merchant Manifest}.
Repeat until five Revered Merchant Manifests have been recovered.

achievements.description: Complete the eight-pirate Glitterbeard tribute on Plunder Valley and read Glitterbeard's final journal.
achievements.estTime: about 30 min after assembling eight players
achievements.summary: Coordinate eight pirates at sunset on @loc{Plunder Valley}, play @mechanic{Becalmed} in the correct positions, and read Glitterbeard's final journal.

guide.context: The ritual needs eight pirates, normally requiring cooperation from another crew. The playable window begins just after sunset and lasts only a short time.

steps.text: Bring eight pirates to the bottle-covered tree on the northwest side of @loc{Plunder Valley} shortly before sunset.
Place one pirate on each marked spot: banjos west and east, hurdy-gurdies north and south, concertinas southeast and northwest, and drums northeast and southwest.
Immediately after sunset, all eight pirates must play @mechanic{Becalmed} without moving or stopping until the bottles glow and the hideout opens.
Enter the opening behind the tree and read Glitterbeard's final journal.

achievements.description: Supplies from the Merchants will save you a wait. Buy every Resource and Commodity Crate!
achievements.summary: Purchase every Resource Crate and every Commodity Crate from Merchant Alliance Senior Traders.

guide.context: Commodity Crates can be purchased only while the crew flies a Merchant Alliance Emissary Flag. Progress persists across sessions.

steps.text: Visit Merchant Alliance Senior Traders and purchase each available Resource Crate type.
Raise the @mechanic{Merchant Alliance Emissary Flag}, then purchase every distinct Commodity Crate type from the Senior Trader.
Repeat across restocks or sessions until every Resource and Commodity Crate type has been purchased at least once.

achievements.description: Complete 'A Pirate's Life'.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{A Pirate's Life} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: All five A Pirate's Life Tall Tales start from the Castaway's Camp at an Outpost. Completion credit is separate from the optional all-commendations achievement.

steps.text: Vote for @mechanic{A Pirate's Life} at @loc{The Castaway's Camp} on any Outpost.
Follow the Tall Tale checkpoints and objectives until the final encounter or hand-in confirms @mechanic{A Pirate's Life} complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'A Pirate's Life'.
achievements.summary: Complete every commendation in the @mechanic{A Pirate's Life} Tall Tale, including ten journals and the Poor Dougie side quest.

guide.context: Finish the side route before using the lighthouse to summon the Ferry of the Damned; progressing the main objective first can close access to its linked commendations for that run.

steps.text: During the Sailor's Grave section, dig up Poor Dougie beneath the dock by following the gold trail, recover and return his treasure, and take Dougie's Medallion.

Recover the Special Recipe from the cave beside the pulley-platform route, place it by the chess skeletons, put the Cursed Captain on the headless body, and use Dougie's Medallion to win the Ship's Key.
Use the Ship's Key on the locked ship near the pulley platforms, rotate its sails, then aim the lighthouse beam at the ship's brazier before summoning the Ferry.
Read all ten Headless Monkey and Cursed Captain journals and finish every remaining A Pirate's Life commendation shown in the Pirate Log.

achievements.description: Complete 'The Sunken Pearl'.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{The Sunken Pearl} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: All five A Pirate's Life Tall Tales start from the Castaway's Camp at an Outpost. Completion credit is separate from the optional all-commendations achievement.

steps.text: Vote for @mechanic{The Sunken Pearl} at @loc{The Castaway's Camp} on any Outpost.
Follow the Tall Tale checkpoints and objectives until the final encounter or hand-in confirms @mechanic{The Sunken Pearl} complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'The Sunken Pearl'.
achievements.summary: Complete every commendation in @mechanic{The Sunken Pearl}, including five journals and the Chest of Everlasting Sorrow route.

guide.context: The Silver Blade Key must be carried forward from the pulley room to the ship battle; the Chest of Everlasting Sorrow then opens a separate inscription chamber later in the Tall Tale.

steps.text: Read the five Silver Blade Captain journals: in the first siren-statue room, the flooded upper alcove, just beyond the large underwater stone door, beside the yellow-orb Siren, and inside the hanging wreck's cabin.
Take the @item{Silver Blade Key} from the red-lit tunnel mouth in the pulley-platform chamber and use it on the Silver Blade's cabin during the Kraken encounter.
Carry the @item{Chest of Everlasting Sorrow} through the coral barrier, place it before the large red-coral door, and read all five inscriptions after the door opens.
Finish every remaining Sunken Pearl commendation shown in the Pirate Log.

achievements.description: Complete 'Captains of the Damned'.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Captains of the Damned} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: All five A Pirate's Life Tall Tales start from the Castaway's Camp at an Outpost. Completion credit is separate from the optional all-commendations achievement.

steps.text: Vote for @mechanic{Captains of the Damned} at @loc{The Castaway's Camp} on any Outpost.
Follow the Tall Tale checkpoints and objectives until the final encounter or hand-in confirms @mechanic{Captains of the Damned} complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'Captains of the Damned'.
achievements.summary: Complete every commendation in @mechanic{Captains of the Damned}, including ten journals and the three optional side actions.

guide.context: Each Sea of the Damned journal appears only after its nearby flame is lit. The Mercado Key, prisoners, and cannon shot must be handled before leaving their respective areas.

steps.text: Light the relevant flames and read five Sea of the Damned journals across the swamp and Fort of Lost Souls, then read the five Townsfolk journals along the town route.
Take the Mercado Key from the well, unlock and light the Mercado window, follow the river to the digging phantoms, dig up their treasure, and return it to the skeleton rowboat.
Use the town-wall cannon to hit the ghost ship for Strike Yer Colours, and use the keys from the dog's bowl to free the ghost prisoners before opening the main-path door.
Complete every remaining Captains of the Damned commendation in the Pirate Log.

achievements.description: Complete 'Dark Brethren'.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Dark Brethren} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: All five A Pirate's Life Tall Tales start from the Castaway's Camp at an Outpost. Completion credit is separate from the optional all-commendations achievement.

steps.text: Vote for @mechanic{Dark Brethren} at @loc{The Castaway's Camp} on any Outpost.
Follow the Tall Tale checkpoints and objectives until the final encounter or hand-in confirms @mechanic{Dark Brethren} complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'Dark Brethren'.
achievements.summary: Complete every commendation in @mechanic{Dark Brethren}, including ten Coral Fortress journals, the Siren murals, and three optional actions.

guide.context: Secret Waters is available only on the first slide, and Dark Desires requires letting the Brethren Court dialogue finish without interruption.

steps.text: Read all ten journals in order through the Coral Fortress, checking wreckage, coral ledges, the organ room, cages, lower platforms, the water-raising room, and the Brethren Court.
Inspect every Siren mural encountered in the fortress.

Hold right during the first slide for Secret Waters, listen to the entire Brethren Court meeting for Dark Desires, and rotate the Court blocks to Shark, Merfolk, Trident, Diamonds, and Ship clockwise from bottom-left.
Take the revealed key, open the Dead Man's Chest, and finish every remaining Dark Brethren commendation.

achievements.description: Complete 'Lords of the Sea'.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Lords of the Sea} Tall Tale once.

guide.context: All five A Pirate's Life Tall Tales start from the Castaway's Camp at an Outpost. Completion credit is separate from the optional all-commendations achievement.

steps.text: Vote for @mechanic{Lords of the Sea} at @loc{The Castaway's Camp} on any Outpost.
Follow the Tall Tale checkpoints and objectives until the final encounter or hand-in confirms @mechanic{Lords of the Sea} complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'Lords of the Sea'.
achievements.estTime: at least two Tall Tale runs
achievements.summary: Complete every commendation in @mechanic{Lords of the Sea}, including all journals, 20 qualifying Ghost Ships, and ten Siren Statues.

guide.context: Only the earlier three-cannonball Ghost Ships count toward the 20-ship commendation. At most five Siren Statues are available per run, so the statue requirement needs at least two completions.

steps.text: During the spire ascent, read all five Journals of Forsaken Souls, then read the Journals of the Black Pearl aboard the ship near the finale.
Destroy 20 of the early Ghost Ships that sink after three cannonball hits.
Destroy every Siren Statue you encounter and replay the Tall Tale until ten statues have been destroyed.
Finish every remaining Lords of the Sea commendation in the Pirate Log.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for the 'Sea of Thieves: A Pirate's Life' Tall Tales.
achievements.summary: Complete all commendations across all five @mechanic{Sea of Thieves: A Pirate's Life} Tall Tales.

guide.context: First finish the all-commendations goals for @mechanic{A Pirate's Life} and @mechanic{The Sunken Pearl}. The same is required from @mechanic{Captains of the Damned}, @mechanic{Dark Brethren}, and @mechanic{Lords of the Sea}.

steps.text: Complete every commendation for @mechanic{A Pirate's Life}, @mechanic{The Sunken Pearl}, and @mechanic{Captains of the Damned}.
Complete every commendation for @mechanic{Dark Brethren} and @mechanic{Lords of the Sea}.
Open Pirate Log > Reputation > Tall Tales and confirm every A Pirate's Life commendation is complete.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery of the Shrine of Hungering Commendation.
achievements.summary: Read all five journals inside the @loc{Shrine of Hungering} to complete its mystery commendation.

guide.context: The five journals are fixed within this shrine and can be collected in one visit; read each journal rather than merely approaching it.

collectibles.name: Shrine of Hungering
collectibles.method: Read the journal held by the skeleton on the ground while swimming through the entrance cave.

collectibles.name: The Warrior
collectibles.method: After raising the water, read the journal inside the broken rowboat on the second platform.

collectibles.name: The Warrior - Unmasked
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside the planks on the top platform with the geyser.

collectibles.name: The High Priest
collectibles.method: After crossing the second set of bones, read the journal left of the Merfolk Statue.

collectibles.name: A Great Evil
collectibles.method: Read the journal just below the Siren Window as you enter the final water-filled chamber.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery of the Shrine of Flooded Embrace Commendation.
achievements.summary: Read all five journals inside the @loc{Shrine of Flooded Embrace} to complete its mystery commendation.

guide.context: The five journals are fixed within this shrine and can be collected in one visit; read each journal rather than merely approaching it.

collectibles.name: Shrine of Flooded Embrace
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside yellow coral inside the hull used to enter the shrine.

collectibles.name: The Sirens
collectibles.method: Open the interactable ceiling door one level below the wreck and read the journal behind it.

collectibles.name: Mermaid Gems
collectibles.method: Read the journal among orange spike coral opposite the Sunken Merfolk Statue.

collectibles.name: Siren Gems
collectibles.method: Read the journal on blue coral atop the overturned shipwreck hull.

collectibles.name: A Great Battle
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside blue coral to the right of the Breath of the Sea pedestal.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery of the Shrine of Ocean's Fortune Commendation.
achievements.summary: Read all five journals inside the @loc{Shrine of Ocean's Fortune} to complete its mystery commendation.

guide.context: The five journals are fixed within this shrine and can be collected in one visit; read each journal rather than merely approaching it.

collectibles.name: Your Beautiful World
collectibles.method: Read the journal in a plank pile immediately to the right after entering.

collectibles.name: I'm Close, I Can Feel It
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside blue-glowing seaweed on the route to the iron-door lever.

collectibles.name: Love is Stronger than Hate
collectibles.method: After defeating the skeleton wave, read the journal beneath turquoise coral at the hairpin turn.

collectibles.name: I Have Failed You
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside blue coral on shipwreck debris on the north-northwest side.

collectibles.name: Do Not Give Up Hope
collectibles.method: Read the journal by blue coral in the shipwreck to the right of the Merfolk Statue.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery of the Shrine of the Coral Tomb Commendation.
achievements.summary: Read all five journals inside the @loc{Shrine of the Coral Tomb} to complete its mystery commendation.

guide.context: The five journals are fixed within this shrine and can be collected in one visit; read each journal rather than merely approaching it.

collectibles.name: Seashell Earring
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside the Ammo Chest.

collectibles.name: A Hidden Kingdom
collectibles.method: Read the journal down and left of the yellow-gem lever.

collectibles.name: The Sea Queen and her Warrior
collectibles.method: Read the journal beside pink coral immediately after entering the cave.

collectibles.name: The Whispering Plague
collectibles.method: After raising the water, read the journal beside the skull pile.

collectibles.name: The Sunken Kingdom
collectibles.method: After raising the water, read the journal to the right of the Merfolk Statue.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery of the Shrine of Ancient Tears Commendation.
achievements.summary: Read all five journals inside the @loc{Shrine of Ancient Tears} to complete its mystery commendation.

guide.context: The five journals are fixed within this shrine and can be collected in one visit; read each journal rather than merely approaching it.

collectibles.name: Shrine of Ancient Tears
collectibles.method: Read the journal to the right of the stone table beside the central water pool.

collectibles.name: Strange Tales
collectibles.method: Drain or descend into the central pit and read the journal on the table at the bottom.

collectibles.name: Return of the Silver Blade
collectibles.method: Enter the enclosed area opposite the treasure vault and read the journal.

collectibles.name: Fate of the Silver Blade
collectibles.method: Open the western door from the main chamber and read the journal left of the Crab Pillar.

collectibles.name: The Chest of Everlasting Sorrow
collectibles.method: Read the journal on the barrel in the room east of the main chamber's second floor.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery of the Shrine of Tribute Commendation.
achievements.summary: Read all five journals inside the @loc{Shrine of Tribute} to complete its mystery commendation.

guide.context: The five journals are fixed within this shrine and can be collected in one visit; read each journal rather than merely approaching it.

collectibles.name: Shrine of Tribute
collectibles.method: After swimming down inside, read the journal on the stone pile opposite the Siren depictions.

collectibles.name: My Friends!
collectibles.method: Read the journal at the base of the first undersea vent south of the Siren depictions.

collectibles.name: The Warrior and the Sea Queen
collectibles.method: From the horn-bearing Siren Statue, head east and read the journal on a stone at the red-coral entrance.

collectibles.name: The Sea Queen's Army
collectibles.method: Raise the water, cross the stone Titan, and read the journal on purple coral to the west.

collectibles.name: Mermaid Gems
collectibles.method: Move the central stone Titan and read the journal on the stone table in the chamber below.

achievements.description: Complete the Marauder of the Sunken Kingdom Commendation.
achievements.summary: Sell 30 Breaths of the Sea, 50 Coral Skulls, 25 Coral Chests, 25 Coral Relics, and 50 Coral Coffers.

guide.context: Breaths of the Sea come from Coral Message in a Bottle quests; the bottles glow blue and can appear on beaches, in floating barrels, or in shipwrecks.

steps.text: Find blue-glowing Coral Messages in a Bottle and complete their shrine or treasury quests until 30 @item{Breaths of the Sea} have been sold.
Explore Siren Shrines and Siren Treasuries, then sell 50 Coral Skulls, 25 Coral Chests, 25 Coral Relics, and 50 Coral Coffers.
Track all five counters under Pirate Log > Bilge Rats > Sunken Kingdom until Marauder of the Sunken Kingdom completes.

achievements.description: Complete the Seeker of the Sea Commendation.
achievements.summary: Sell 30 @item{Breaths of the Sea} recovered through Coral Message in a Bottle quests.

guide.context: A Breath of the Sea spawns only when its corresponding Coral Message quest is active. The blue-glowing messages can be found on beaches, in floating barrels, or in shipwrecks.

steps.text: Collect a blue-glowing @item{Coral Message in a Bottle} and follow its quest to the named Siren Shrine or Treasury.
Complete the underwater objective, retrieve the @item{Breath of the Sea}, and sell it to a Trading Company representative.
Repeat until 30 Breaths of the Sea have been sold.

achievements.description: Complete all Sunken Kingdom Commendations.
achievements.summary: Complete all 31 @mechanic{Sunken Kingdom} commendations.

guide.context: The full set covers visiting all six shrines, clearing each treasury, selling coral loot, defeating 250 Sirens and 250 Ocean Crawlers, reading 30 shrine journals, and finishing the unlocked voyage.

steps.text: Visit all six Siren Shrines, complete each Siren Treasury at least once, and read all five journals in every shrine.
Complete the coral-loot sales counters and defeat 250 @enemy{Sirens} plus 250 @enemy{Ocean Crawlers}.
After reading all 30 journals, complete the Legend of the Sunken Kingdom voyage from the ship's Quest Table.
Finish any remaining commendation shown under Pirate Log > Bilge Rats > Sunken Kingdom.

achievements.description: You stole a Map Bundle from another crew.
achievements.summary: Steal another crew's @item{Map Bundle} and place the stolen Map Bundle on your own ship's Quest Table.

guide.context: A Map Bundle exists only after a crew buries treasure. It remains a physical item on that crew's Quest Table and can also be recovered after their ship sinks.

steps.text: Find a crew that has buried treasure, then board or sink its ship.
Pick up the @item{Map Bundle} from the other crew's Quest Table or from the wreckage after the ship sinks.
Carry the stolen Map Bundle to your own ship and place it on your Quest Table.

achievements.description: You attacked a Megalodon or Kraken using a Cannon Rowboat.
achievements.summary: Hit a @enemy{Megalodon} or @enemy{Kraken} 25 times with a @item{Cannon Rowboat}.

guide.context: A Cannon Rowboat can remain docked to the stern while fired, so storing one until a sea-monster encounter avoids rowing independently.

steps.text: Find a @item{Cannon Rowboat} on an island shoreline and dock it to your ship.
During a Megalodon or Kraken encounter, load the rowboat cannon and hit the creature.
Continue firing qualifying hits across encounters until the commendation reaches 25.

achievements.description: You set off a display of five or more fireworks at night.
achievements.summary: Launch at least five @item{Fireworks} during one in-game night.

guide.context: Fireworks can be found in barrels or purchased from Merchant Alliance Senior Traders; all five must be launched within the same night cycle.

steps.text: Stock at least five @item{Fireworks} and load them into a ship cannon after night begins.
Fire five fireworks before daylight returns.

achievements.description: You took a seat upon the throne during the 'Shores of Gold' Tall Tale.
achievements.summary: During @mechanic{Shores of Gold}, defeat the Gold Hoarder and sit on the golden throne in his boss arena.

guide.context: The throne is available at Tribute Peak only during the Shores of Gold Tall Tale and should be used after the boss fight.

steps.text: Vote for and progress the @mechanic{Shores of Gold} Tall Tale to @loc{Tribute Peak}.
Defeat @enemy{The Gold Hoarder} in the final chamber.
Use the Sit prompt on the golden throne in the boss arena.

achievements.description: Sleep in a bed aboard another crew's ship.
achievements.summary: Use a bed aboard another crew's ship and remain in the sleeping pose.

guide.context: The target must belong to another crew; an alliance is the safest way to board and use the bed without interruption.

steps.text: Board a ship owned by another crew, either with permission or by sneaking aboard.
Approach a usable bed and select @mechanic{Sleep}, then remain in the sleeping pose until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: You rolled a natural 20 using the Roll a D20 Emote.
achievements.summary: Use the @mechanic{Roll a D20 Emote} until the die displays a natural 20.

guide.context: Each D20 roll has a 5% chance to show 20. The emote is available from Larinna for 300 Doubloons if it was not previously unlocked.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Roll a D20 Emote} from @npc{Larinna} outside an Outpost tavern for 300 Doubloons if needed.
Equip Roll a D20 from a Vanity Chest.
Perform the emote repeatedly until the die lands on 20.

achievements.description: You buried treasures for safekeeping.
achievements.summary: Bury 25 eligible treasure items.

guide.context: The related Bilge Rats commendation is graded and cumulative, so the 25 burials can be spread across islands and sessions.

steps.text: Place an eligible treasure item on diggable ground and use the shovel to bury it completely.
Repeat with 25 treasure items, checking Pirate Log > Bilge Rats > Buried Treasures for progress.

achievements.description: You donated Treasure Stash maps to a Quest Board.
achievements.summary: Donate 25 @item{Treasure Stash Maps} to Outpost Quest Boards.

guide.context: A Treasure Stash Map is created when treasure is buried on an island; submitting the generated map to a Quest Board donates it for other crews.

steps.text: Bury one or more treasure items on an island to create a @item{Treasure Stash Map}.
Return to an Outpost, open the @mechanic{Quest Board}, and donate the map.
Repeat until 25 Treasure Stash Maps have been donated.

achievements.description: You uncovered valuable treasures buried by other pirate crews.
achievements.summary: Use Quest Board maps to uncover 25 treasures buried by other crews.

guide.context: Quest Boards receive generated maps even on servers without player donations, so a supply of eligible maps remains available.

steps.text: Take a Treasure Stash Map from an Outpost @mechanic{Quest Board}.
Sail to the mapped island and dig at each marked X until the buried treasure is uncovered.
Repeat until 25 treasures from other crews' Quest Board maps have been uncovered.

achievements.description: You completed all Buried Treasures Commendations.
achievements.summary: Complete every commendation in the @mechanic{Buried Treasures} Bilge Rats set.

guide.context: This meta-set contains graded counters and one-off actions across PvP, map donation, Cannon Rowboats, fireworks, and sitting locations. Progress persists, and the Pirate Log shows each commendation tier.

collectibles.name: Sleepover
