collectibles.method: Use a firework to start a fire aboard another crew's ship.

collectibles.name: Warning Shot
collectibles.method: Launch a Signal Flare while another crew is nearby.

collectibles.name: Down With the Ship
collectibles.method: Sit in your Galleon's Captain's Chair while the ship sinks; scuttling from My Crew can trigger the condition.

collectibles.name: Seat of Thieves
collectibles.method: Sit at a tavern table beside other pirates.

collectibles.name: Rest of Legends
collectibles.method: Take a seat anywhere inside the Pirate Legend Hideout.

collectibles.name: Tavern Crawl
collectibles.method: Use a seat inside each of the seven taverns.

collectibles.name: Moment of Reflection
collectibles.method: Sit at the end of a dock while the sun sets.

collectibles.name: A New Day
collectibles.method: Sit on the highest peak in The Wilds at sunrise, around 5:00 in-game.

collectibles.name: Catching Rays
collectibles.method: Sit on the highest peak in The Ancient Isles at noon.

collectibles.name: Adventurer's Eve
collectibles.method: Sit on the highest peak in The Shores of Plenty at sunset, around 20:00 in-game.

collectibles.name: A Golden Throne
collectibles.method: Sit on the Treasury throne during the Tall Tale.

collectibles.name: This is Fine
collectibles.method: Set your ship on fire, then use a seat while the deck is burning.

collectibles.name: Hot Seat
collectibles.method: Sit on an island while that island's volcano is erupting.

achievements.description: Open a Sea Fort Treasury
achievements.summary: Clear any @loc{Sea Fort}, take the @item{Fortress Treasury Key}, and open its lower Treasury Vault.

guide.context: An active Sea Fort shows a raised flag and ghostly lights. The captain in the final Phantom wave drops the Fortress Treasury Key.

steps.text: Sail or dive to an active @loc{Sea Fort} and defeat all eight waves of @enemy{Sea Fort Phantoms}.
Pick up the @item{Fortress Treasury Key} dropped after the final wave.
Take the key to the lower-level Treasury Vault and use it to open the door.

achievements.description: Discover 100 secret stashed treasures on a Sea Fort
achievements.summary: Find 100 qualifying hidden treasure items inside Sea Fort cupboards, boxes, and locked upper rooms.

guide.context: Gold pouches and items in the main Treasury cupboards do not count. The Store Room Key and the gem inside its upper room each count as hidden finds.

steps.text: Clear or explore Sea Forts and open every interactive cupboard, cabinet, box, and shelf outside the main Treasury reward.
Search for the @item{Store Room Key}, unlock the upper treasure room, and collect its hidden gem.
Repeat Sea Fort searches until the Bilge Rats > Sea Forts commendation reaches 100 hidden treasures.

achievements.description: Defeat 250 Sea Fort Phantoms
achievements.summary: Defeat 250 @enemy{Sea Fort Phantoms} inside Sea Fort encounters.

guide.context: Only the Spanish-fortress Phantoms at Sea Forts count; ordinary Phantoms elsewhere do not.

steps.text: Sail or dive to active @loc{Sea Forts}.
Defeat all eight short waves of @enemy{Sea Fort Phantoms} on each clear.
Repeat Sea Forts until Pirate Log > Bilge Rats > Sea Forts records 250 Phantom defeats.

achievements.description: Complete 100 Legend of the Veil Quests
achievements.summary: Complete 100 @mechanic{Legend of the Veil} Voyages after becoming Pirate Legend.

guide.context: The first two chapters are randomly selected, while the final chapter ends after the Ghost Garrison is destroyed and the last Veil Stone is placed into the Veil of the Ancients.

steps.text: Become Pirate Legend and start a @mechanic{Legend of the Veil} Voyage.
Complete the two random opening chapters, destroy the final Ghost Garrison's vulnerable structures, and collect the last @item{Veil Stone}.
Insert the final Veil Stone into the @item{Veil of the Ancients} to complete the voyage; repeat until 100 completions are recorded.

achievements.description: Sell 500 Legendary Treasures
achievements.summary: Sell 500 qualifying @mechanic{Legendary Treasures} to Athena's Fortune.

guide.context: Athena loot introduced with and after Legend of the Veil counts toward the cumulative commendation.

steps.text: Complete Athena's Fortune Voyages, especially Legend of the Veil, and collect their Legendary Treasures.
Sell qualifying Athena loot to the @npc{Mysterious Stranger} or to the Sovereigns while eligible.
Continue until the Athena's Fortune commendation records 500 Legendary Treasures sold.

achievements.description: Complete 25 Legend of the Veil Voyages as a Grade 5 Athena Emissary
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{25 Legend of the Veil Voyages}, with every completion made while your Athena's Fortune Emissary Flag is at Grade 5.

guide.context: A Legend of the Veil Voyage normally supplies enough Emissary Grade progress to reach Grade 5 if the crew keeps its loot and is not sunk. Completion occurs when the final Veil Stone enters the mask.

steps.text: Raise an @mechanic{Athena's Fortune Emissary Flag} and begin a Legend of the Veil Voyage.
Collect the voyage treasure and protect the ship until the Emissary Flag reaches Grade 5.
Destroy the Ghost Garrison, recover the final @item{Veil Stone}, and place it into the Veil of the Ancients while the flag is still Grade 5.
Repeat for 25 Grade-5 voyage completions.

achievements.description: Set sail on a Captained ship as one of the crew.
achievements.summary: Set sail as a crewmate aboard another player's @mechanic{Captained Ship}.

guide.context: A Captained Ship shows its custom name when viewed through a spyglass. Joining a friend's Captained session or finding one through Open Crew both qualify.

steps.text: Join a crew whose owner launched a purchased @mechanic{Captained Ship}.
Leave the Outpost and set sail as a member of that crew.

achievements.description: Stock your ship with each type of supply using the Ship's Manifest.
achievements.summary: On a Captained Ship, buy every supply category from the Shipwright's @mechanic{Ship's Manifest}.

guide.context: Budget about 18,250 gold for the complete Ship's Manifest order; loose supplies and items placed manually into the ship's barrels do not satisfy the purchase requirement.

steps.text: Launch a purchased @mechanic{Captained Ship} and speak to the @npc{Shipwright} at an Outpost.
Open the @mechanic{Ship's Manifest} supply menu.
Purchase Wood, Cannonballs, Food, Meat, Bait, and Throwables supplies.

achievements.description: Read another crew's Captain's Log.
achievements.summary: Read the @item{Captain's Logbook} belonging to another crew's Captained Ship.

guide.context: Every Captained Ship carries its logbook near the Quest Table. A sunk Captained Ship drops the logbook with its wreckage.

steps.text: Identify another crew's Captained Ship by its displayed ship name.
Board the ship and read the @item{Captain's Logbook} beside its Quest Table, or sink the ship and read the dropped logbook.

achievements.description: Place 15 trinkets aboard a Captained ship at once.
achievements.summary: Place 15 @item{Trinkets} simultaneously in mounting spots aboard a Captained Ship.

guide.context: Captained Ships begin with five default trinkets, so additional ornaments may need to be purchased. Valid placement points include walls, ledges, the stove, and other highlighted mounts.

steps.text: Launch a @mechanic{Captained Ship} and acquire enough distinct or repeat-placeable trinkets to fill 15 mounts.
Enter ship-decoration mode and place trinkets on 15 highlighted wall, shelf, ledge, stove, or furniture positions.
Confirm that all 15 trinkets remain placed at the same time.

achievements.description: Save a fully-decorated, Captained ship in the Ship Decoration Chest.
achievements.summary: Equip and save every required exterior and interior decoration category on a Captained Ship.

guide.context: Default Sailor cosmetics qualify, but a flag must be equipped. A ship title is not required; a Galleon has extra interior categories.

steps.text: On a Captained Ship, equip Hull, Sails, Cannons, Wheel, Capstan, Figurehead, and Flag cosmetics.
Equip the required interior categories: Rug, Table, Drapes, Bed, Ship Crest, Logbook, Banner, and the Galleon's Chair, Chandelier, and Curtains when applicable.
Use the @mechanic{Ship Decoration Chest} option to save the fully decorated loadout to the Captained Ship.

achievements.description: Spend 10 days at sea aboard a Captained ship, either as the Captain or one of the crew.
achievements.summary: Accumulate ten in-game days at sea aboard Captained Ships as Captain or crewmate.

guide.context: One Sea of Thieves day lasts 24 real minutes, and the ten-day counter is cumulative across play sessions.

steps.text: Join or launch a @mechanic{Captained Ship} and leave the Outpost.
Remain at sea aboard Captained Ships for a cumulative ten in-game days, equal to about 240 real minutes.

achievements.description: Complete 30 Voyages aboard a Captained Ship.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{30 Voyages} while aboard any Captained Ship.

guide.context: Progress counts while serving as either captain or crewmate; the January 2024 requirement no longer limits eligible Voyage types.

steps.text: Sail on a purchased Captained Ship or join another player's Captained Ship.
Start and finish any Voyages until the Captained Ship total reaches @mechanic{30}.

achievements.description: Hand in 200 treasure items to the Sovereigns.
achievements.summary: Deliver @mechanic{200 treasure items} to the @npc{Sovereigns} while sailing as captain of a Captained Ship.

guide.context: Sovereigns occupy the tall purple tent at the seven main Outposts and accept loot for the three main Companies and Athena's Fortune.

steps.text: Set sail as captain of a ship you own.
Carry treasure to the @npc{Sovereigns} until @mechanic{200 items} have been handed in.

achievements.description: Set sail as a Captain of Adventure for the first time.
achievements.summary: Purchase a ship, choose @mechanic{Sail for Adventure}, and enter the session as its captain.

guide.context: A Sloop costs 250,000 gold, a Brigantine 375,000, and a Galleon 500,000.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{My Ships} to buy and select one of your ships.
Choose @mechanic{Sail for Adventure} and load into the sea.

achievements.description: Purchase a cherished trinket.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{Class 30} in one Pirate Milestone and purchase its @item{Cherished Trinket}.

guide.context: A full trinket upgrade chain costs 300,000 gold, and Cherished is the final tier.

steps.text: Progress one Pirate Milestone to @mechanic{Class 30}.
At the Shipwright's trinket shop, buy each earlier tier and then the Cherished tier.

achievements.description: Unlock a Legendary Title by progressing your Pirate Milestones.
achievements.summary: Raise one @mechanic{Pirate Milestone Alignment} to Class 50 to unlock its Legendary Pirate Title.

guide.context: Pirate Milestones progress across all Captained Ships and do not require you to be the current captain.

steps.text: Sail aboard Captained Ships and repeatedly perform one Alignment's activities.
Continue until that Pirate Alignment reaches @mechanic{Class 50}.

achievements.description: Unlock a Legendary Ship Title by progressing your Ship Milestones.
achievements.summary: Raise one @mechanic{Ship Milestone Alignment} to Class 50 on a single ship you own.

guide.context: Ship Milestones are tied to one owned vessel; crew contributions count only while that vessel sails as a Captained Ship.

steps.text: Choose one owned ship and consistently sail that vessel as a Captained Ship.
Repeat one Alignment's activities until that ship reaches @mechanic{Class 50}.

achievements.description: Own 15 ships.
achievements.summary: Own @mechanic{15 Captained Ships}, unlocking duplicate purchases through Legendary Ship Milestones.

guide.context: You can initially own one ship of each size; another of the same size requires a Legendary Milestone on the relevant vessel.

steps.text: Buy one Sloop, Brigantine, and Galleon.
Reach Class 50 Ship Milestones and buy additional vessels until the fleet contains @mechanic{15 ships}.

achievements.description: Win your first fight in the Battle for the Sea of Thieves.
achievements.summary: Use the @item{Hourglass of Fate} to join a Faction battle and sink the opposing ship.

guide.context: You may seek an opponent through the War Map or remain available for invasion; either route counts.

steps.text: At the Voyage Table, vote on the @item{Hourglass of Fate} for either Faction.
Use the War Map or wait for an invasion, then sink the matched opponent.

achievements.description: Sink 100 Faction ships in the Battle for the Sea of Thieves.
achievements.summary: Sink @mechanic{100 opposing Faction ships} in Battle for the Sea of Thieves matches.

guide.context: Victories for both Factions share one counter, whether earned for Guardians of Fortune or Servants of the Flame.

steps.text: Enter matched Faction battles with the @item{Hourglass of Fate}.
Win by sinking opposing ships until the combined counter reaches @mechanic{100}.

achievements.description: Earn an Allegiance Streak of 4 for either Faction.
achievements.summary: Win @mechanic{4 consecutive Faction battles} without lowering the Hourglass or losing your ship.

guide.context: Lowering the Hourglass to cash in Sands of Fate ends the streak, as does being sunk.

steps.text: Vote for either Faction with the @item{Hourglass of Fate}.
Sink four matched enemy ships back-to-back while keeping the streak active.

achievements.description: Receive the Blessing of Athena's Fortune.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{Guardians of Fortune Allegiance 100} as a Pirate Legend, then receive the Blessing from the @npc{Pirate Lord}.

guide.context: The extended Athena's Fortune Hideout remains locked until Guardians Allegiance 100 and Pirate Legend status are both complete.

steps.text: Reach Guardians Allegiance 100 and qualify as @mechanic{Pirate Legend}.
Enter Athena's Fortune Hideout, speak to the Pirate Lord, and proceed through the opened door.

achievements.description: Undergo the Ritual of the Flame.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{Servants of the Flame Allegiance 100} and Reaper's Bones rank 75, then undergo the Ritual at Reaper's Hideout.

guide.context: The Servant of the Flame opens the ritual-area elevator after Servants Allegiance 100 and Reaper's Bones rank 75 are both complete.

steps.text: Reach Servants Allegiance 100 and Reaper's Bones rank 75.
At @loc{Reaper's Hideout}, speak to the Servant, use the elevator, and complete the Ritual.

achievements.description: Uncover a Skull of Destiny.
achievements.summary: Complete the Pirate Legend @item{Skull of Destiny} Voyage and dig up the destination skull.

guide.context: The Pirate Legend Voyage yields a skull that supplies all six Flames of Fate and substitutes for a Ritual Skull.

steps.text: As a Pirate Legend, select the Voyage for the @item{Skull of Destiny}.
Follow its map and uncover the skull.

achievements.description: Use a Skull of Destiny to begin 3 Fort of the Damned events.
achievements.summary: Activate @loc{Fort of the Damned} @mechanic{3 times} by supplying each ritual with a @item{Skull of Destiny}.

guide.context: Each skull can light all six braziers and then serve as the ritual sacrifice.

steps.text: Use a Skull of Destiny's flame modes to light all six Fort braziers.
Place the skull on the ritual skeleton; repeat the activation @mechanic{3 times}.

achievements.description: Conquer 3 Forts of Fortune.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{3 Forts of Fortune} by defeating every wave and opening each event vault.

guide.context: The emergent event is marked by a cracked skull cloud with red eyes; dived Raid Voyages are not the same event.

steps.text: Defeat the skeleton waves and final Ashen Lord at an active Fort of Fortune.
Use the key to open the vault, and repeat for @mechanic{3 completions}.

achievements.description: Hand in 30 Reaper's Chests or Reaper's Bounties.
achievements.summary: Sell a combined @mechanic{30 Reaper's Chests or Reaper's Bounties} to Reaper's Bones.

guide.context: Reaper's Chests and Reaper's Bounties appear in shipwrecks and Fort of the Damned rewards, remain map-marked, and share one counter.

steps.text: Recover either eligible chest type.
Deliver the eligible chests to Reaper's Bones at @loc{Reaper's Hideout} until the combined total is @mechanic{30}.

achievements.description: Hand in 30 Chests of Fortune.
achievements.summary: Sell @mechanic{30 Chests of Fortune} to Gold Hoarders, Reaper's Bones, or Sovereigns.

guide.context: The Chest of Fortune's event location changes by Season, and dived Raid Voyages do not award a Chest of Fortune.

steps.text: Complete the current emergent world event that rewards a @item{Chest of Fortune}.
Sell the chests until Fortune's Favour reaches @mechanic{30}.

achievements.description: Complete 'The Journey to Mêlée Island' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Begin @mechanic{Journey to Mêlée Island} at the Castaway and finish one Tall Tale run.

guide.context: Optional commendations are not required for this first-completion unlock.

steps.text: Use the Tale book beside the @npc{Castaway} to begin the Tall Tale.
Complete its final sequence.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'The Journey to Mêlée Island'.
achievements.summary: Earn every one of the @mechanic{16 commendations} attached to Journey to Mêlée Island.

guide.context: Missable-in-run tasks include 10 Root Beer defeats, six Spiffy dialogue lines, Murray's guided tour, and ten Memoirs seats; the Tale is replayable.

steps.text: Complete the story and every side condition shown in its commendation list.
Replay the Tall Tale until all @mechanic{16 commendations} are awarded.

achievements.description: Complete 'The Quest for Guybrush' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{The Quest for Guybrush} from the Castaway and finish the Tall Tale once.

guide.context: Journey to Mêlée Island precedes this second adventure in the Monkey Island arc.

steps.text: Use the corresponding book beside the @npc{Castaway}.
Complete the Tall Tale's final sequence.

achievements.description: Complete all Commendations for 'The Quest for Guybrush'.
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{17 commendations} in The Quest for Guybrush Tall Tale.

guide.context: Notable conditions include a circus performance under 25 seconds, all 20 insult retorts, five journals, and one-time character interactions.

steps.text: Complete every listed story and side condition.
Replay the Tall Tale until all @mechanic{17 commendations} are awarded.

achievements.description: You completed The Lair of LeChuck.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{The Lair of LeChuck} from the Castaway and finish the Tall Tale once.

guide.context: This is the third and final individual Tall Tale in The Legend of Monkey Island arc.

steps.text: Use the corresponding book beside the @npc{Castaway}.
Complete the final confrontation and ending.

achievements.description: You completed all Commendations for 'The Lair of LeChuck'.
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{16 commendations} in The Lair of LeChuck Tall Tale.

guide.context: Ten Castaway notes lie before the stone monkey, while five ghostly journals lie inside the cave system.

steps.text: Finish every story and side condition, including notes, journals, rock-launcher tasks, and ten Memoirs seats.
Replay the Tall Tale until all @mechanic{16 commendations} are awarded.

achievements.description: You completed all Commendations for 'The Legend of Monkey Island' Tall Tales
achievements.summary: Earn every commendation across @mechanic{Journey to Mêlée Island}, @mechanic{Quest for Guybrush}, and @mechanic{Lair of LeChuck}.

guide.context: This meta-achievement depends on the three individual all-commendation awards.

steps.text: Finish the full commendation lists for Journey to Mêlée Island, Quest for Guybrush, and Lair of LeChuck.
Confirm Mêlée Island Investigator, Legendary Trial Master, and Do the Monkey! have unlocked.

achievements.description: Set sail on a ship enrolled in a Guild to which you belong.
achievements.summary: Join a Guild and set sail aboard a ship pledged to that Guild.

guide.context: The ship may belong to another Guild member; ownership is not required.

steps.text: Join or create a @mechanic{Guild}.
From the Guild ship list, set sail on a pledged ship.

achievements.description: Pledge a Captained Ship to a Guild.
achievements.summary: Own a Captained Ship and pledge that ship to a @mechanic{Guild}.

guide.context: Pledging enrolls the vessel in the Guild fleet; merely sailing the privately owned vessel does not satisfy this Guild action.

steps.text: Purchase or select a Captained Ship you own.
Pledge the owned ship through Guild management.

achievements.description: Become a Guild Emissary for the first time for a Guild to which you belong.
achievements.summary: While sailing a Guild ship, vote at a Sovereigns table to raise the @mechanic{Guild Emissary Flag}.

guide.context: Guild Emissary access unlocks when the Guild reaches reputation level 15.

steps.text: Join a level-15 Guild and set sail on one of its pledged ships.
At a Sovereigns tent, vote at the table to represent the Guild.

achievements.description: Set sail representing a Guild you are a member of with Distinction 1 or higher.
achievements.summary: Set sail for a Guild that has earned @mechanic{Distinction 1} or higher.

guide.context: A Guild earns its first Distinction after progressing through reputation level 100.

steps.text: Join a Guild with at least @mechanic{Distinction 1}.
Set sail from that Guild's ship list.

achievements.description: Complete all 'Chef' Guild Commendations.
achievements.summary: Wear all five @item{Chef of the Seas} pieces, then cook 25 dishes, catch 10 Trophy Fish, and sell 10 cooked Kraken or Megalodon meats.

guide.context: The outfit unlocks at Guild level 40, and burnt Kraken or Megalodon meat counts.

steps.text: Equip the Chef Boots, Gloves, Hat, Jacket, and Trousers.
While fully dressed, complete the three listed Chef counters.

achievements.description: Complete all 'Cannoneer' Guild Commendations.
achievements.summary: Wear all six @item{Blasted Cannoneer} pieces, then hit ships 200 times, defeat 10 foes with a Cannon Rowboat, and hit 15 player masts with Chainshots.

guide.context: The outfit unlocks at Guild level 60; skeleton ships count for cannon hits, but the mast task requires player ships.

steps.text: Equip the Blasted Cannoneer Belt, Boots, Gloves, Hat, Shirt, and Trousers.
While fully dressed, complete the three listed Cannoneer counters.

achievements.description: Complete all 'Navigator' Guild Commendations.
achievements.summary: Wear all five @item{Constant Navigator} pieces, then dig up 50 treasures, spyglass 10 Captained Ships, and complete 10 Riddle Quests.

guide.context: The Navigator outfit unlocks at Guild level 20.

steps.text: Equip the Constant Navigator Belt, Boots, Gloves, Trousers, and Shirt.
While fully dressed, complete the three listed Navigator counters.

achievements.description: Complete all 'Helm' Guild Commendations.
achievements.summary: Wear all six @item{Heroic Helm} pieces, then visit 10 islands, defeat 40 Skeleton or Ghost Ships, and defeat 5 Megalodons or Krakens.

guide.context: The Helm outfit unlocks at Guild level 80, and each paired enemy category shares a counter.

steps.text: Equip the Heroic Helm Belt, Boots, Gloves, Hat, Jacket, and Trousers.
While fully dressed, complete the three listed Helm counters.

achievements.description: Complete 'Distinguished' Guild Commendations.
achievements.summary: Complete the ten @mechanic{Distinguished Guild Commendations} unlocked from Guild level 15 through Distinction 9.

guide.context: The set spans more than 900 Guild levels in one Guild; Distinction 10 commendations are not required.

steps.text: Remain in one Guild as that Guild reaches each unlock threshold through Distinction 9.
Complete the Emissary, Sovereign, fishing, sea-monster, map, cannon, enemy, Voyage, Hourglass, and vault objectives.

achievements.description: Awarded the Commendation 'Seeker of The Siren Song Grade 5'
achievements.summary: Dig up @mechanic{50} Siren Song Chests or Siren Song Keys.

guide.context: The Seeker counter combines chest and key digs from Briggsy's two maps.

steps.text: Opt into an active Skull of Siren Song Voyage from the ship's mast.
Follow Briggsy's maps and dig up quest Chests or Keys until the combined total is @mechanic{50}.

achievements.description: Awarded the Commendation 'Sentry of the Siren Song Grade 5'
achievements.summary: Use Siren Song Keys to open @mechanic{40 Chests of Siren Song}.

guide.context: Opening the quest chest reveals the Skull and advances Sentry of the Siren Song.

steps.text: Recover a @item{Siren Song Key} and a @item{Chest of Siren Song} during the Voyage.
Use the key on the chest in @mechanic{40 Voyages}.

achievements.description: Sink a ship carrying a Siren Song Treasure
achievements.summary: Sink another player's ship while a @item{Siren Song Key, Chest, or Skull} is aboard.

guide.context: Any of the three Voyage items makes the enemy ship eligible.

steps.text: Locate a rival ship carrying a Siren Song Key, Chest, or Skull.
Sink that rival ship while the item remains aboard.

achievements.description: Awarded the Commendation 'Savior of the Siren Song Grade 1'
achievements.summary: Give @npc{Captain Briggsy} one recovered @item{Skull of Siren Song}.

guide.context: The Skull is revealed by combining the Voyage key and chest; Briggsy then appears at the marked island.

steps.text: Recover the key and chest, then open the chest.
Bring Captain Briggsy the recovered @item{Skull of Siren Song} and complete the hand-in.

achievements.description: Awarded the Commendation 'Savior of the Siren Song Grade 5'
achievements.summary: Give @npc{Captain Briggsy} a cumulative @mechanic{30 Skulls of Siren Song}.

guide.context: Grade 5 is the last hand-in tier for the Savior of the Siren Song commendation.

steps.text: Complete Skull of Siren Song Voyages and deliver each Skull to Briggsy.
Continue until the cumulative total reaches @mechanic{30}.

achievements.description: Pay a visit to the beautiful Sanctuary Outpost.
achievements.summary: Sail to and step ashore at @loc{Sanctuary Outpost}.

guide.context: Each named settlement has its own visit achievement; no purchase or Company task is required.

steps.text: Navigate to @loc{Sanctuary Outpost} and disembark onto the Outpost.

achievements.description: Pay a visit to the sprawling Port Merrick.
achievements.summary: Sail to and step ashore at @loc{Port Merrick}.

guide.context: Each named settlement has its own visit achievement; no purchase or Company task is required.

steps.text: Navigate to @loc{Port Merrick} and disembark onto the Outpost.

achievements.description: Pay a visit to the towering Plunder Outpost.
achievements.summary: Sail to and step ashore at @loc{Plunder Outpost}.

guide.context: Each named settlement has its own visit achievement; no purchase or Company task is required.

steps.text: Navigate to @loc{Plunder Outpost} and disembark onto the Outpost.

achievements.description: Pay a visit to the unforgettable Ancient Spire Outpost.
achievements.summary: Sail to and step ashore at @loc{Ancient Spire Outpost}.

guide.context: Each named settlement has its own visit achievement; no purchase or Company task is required.

steps.text: Navigate to @loc{Ancient Spire Outpost} and disembark onto the Outpost.

achievements.description: Pay a visit to the imposing Dagger Tooth Outpost.
achievements.summary: Sail to and step ashore at @loc{Dagger Tooth Outpost}.

guide.context: Each named settlement has its own visit achievement; no purchase or Company task is required.

steps.text: Navigate to @loc{Dagger Tooth Outpost} and disembark onto the Outpost.

achievements.description: Pay a visit to the mysterious Galleon’s Grave Outpost.
achievements.summary: Sail to and step ashore at @loc{Galleon's Grave Outpost}.

guide.context: Each named settlement has its own visit achievement; no purchase or Company task is required.

steps.text: Navigate to @loc{Galleon's Grave Outpost} and disembark onto the Outpost.

achievements.description: Earn a Distinction for any Trading Company.
achievements.summary: Earn one @mechanic{Trading Company Distinction} by advancing an eligible Company beyond reputation level 100.

guide.context: A Distinction is awarded when Company reputation crosses its prestige threshold.

steps.text: Choose an eligible Trading Company and continue earning reputation after level 100.
Cross the threshold to receive the next Distinction.

achievements.description: Complete the Tutorial Voyage for the Gold Hoarders, Merchant Alliance and Order of Souls.
achievements.summary: Finish the Tutorial Voyages for @mechanic{Order of Souls}, @mechanic{Gold Hoarders}, and @mechanic{Merchant Alliance}.

guide.context: Tutorial Voyages cannot use Dive to Location; the Pirate Lord accompanies the crew and explains the basic mechanics for each Company's activity.

steps.text: At the Quest Table, complete the Gold Hoarders Tutorial Voyage.
Repeat with the Merchant Alliance and Order of Souls Tutorial Voyages.

achievements.description: Dive to, and complete, a Voyage for the Gold Hoarders.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for a Gold Hoarders Voyage and complete that Voyage.

guide.context: Gold Hoarders Diving remains available now but is scheduled for temporary removal during the Season 21 experiment sometime in September 2026. No exact start day or return date is set, so prioritize this Voyage.

steps.text: Choose a Gold Hoarders Voyage at the Quest Table and select @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, complete every objective.

achievements.description: Dive to, and complete, a Voyage for the Order of Souls.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for an Order of Souls Voyage and complete that Voyage.

guide.context: The Order of Souls @mechanic{Dive to Location} option works currently and is due to become temporarily unavailable during a Season 21 experiment sometime in September 2026. Its removal day and return date are not set.

steps.text: Choose an Order of Souls Voyage at the Quest Table and select @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, defeat the targets and finish the Voyage.

achievements.description: Dive to, and complete, a Voyage for the Merchant Alliance.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for a Merchant Alliance Voyage and complete that Voyage.

guide.context: Merchant Alliance Voyage Diving is currently obtainable but is scheduled to pause for the Season 21 experiment sometime in September 2026. Because neither endpoint has a fixed date, finish this route early.

steps.text: Choose a Merchant Alliance Voyage at the Quest Table and select @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, complete the delivery or recovery objectives.

achievements.description: Dive to, and complete, a Voyage for Athena's Fortune.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for an Athena's Fortune Voyage and complete that Voyage.

guide.context: Athena's Fortune Diving can be completed now and is scheduled for temporary removal as part of the Season 21 experiment sometime in September 2026. The exact removal and restoration dates remain unset.

steps.text: As a Pirate Legend, choose an Athena's Fortune Voyage and @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, finish every objective.

achievements.description: Defeat an Ashen Lord with the Double Barrel Pistol.
achievements.summary: Use a @item{Double Barrel Pistol} to deliver the killing shot against an @enemy{Ashen Lord}.

guide.context: Ashen Lords appear in Ashen Winds events and Forts of Fortune; a dived Ashen Winds Raid offers a direct route.

steps.text: Equip the Double Barrel Pistol and start an Ashen Winds encounter.
Weaken the boss, then deliver the killing shot with that pistol.

achievements.description: Defeat a Skeleton Lord with a ranged throwing knife attack.
achievements.summary: Kill a @enemy{Skeleton Lord} with a thrown @item{Throwing Knife}.

guide.context: Skeleton Lords appear in Skeleton Forts, Order of Souls bounties, and Fort of the Damned; only the ranged throw should deliver the final hit.

steps.text: Equip Throwing Knives and locate a Skeleton Lord.
Weaken the boss, then throw a knife for the killing blow.

achievements.description: Hit a Kraken tentacle with scattershot.
achievements.summary: Fire @item{Scattershot} from a cannon and hit a @enemy{Kraken tentacle}.

guide.context: Krakens can attack ships in open water when no emergent world event is active.

steps.text: Stock Scattershot and wait for a Kraken encounter.
Load the @item{Scattershot} into a ship cannon and hit a raised Kraken tentacle.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy Bone Caller Skeleton with your own Bone Caller Skeleton.
achievements.summary: Have a skeleton summoned by your @item{Bone Caller} kill another crew's Bone Caller Skeleton.

guide.context: The opposing skeleton may be encountered in ship or island combat; cooperation with another crew makes the matchup controllable.

steps.text: Obtain Bone Callers from Skeleton Fort supplies or sunken Skeleton Ship crates.
Have each crew summon skeletons, then protect your summoned skeleton until your skeleton defeats an opposing summoned skeleton.

achievements.description: Use the Horn of Fair Winds to avoid fall damage from a great height.
achievements.summary: Blow a @item{Horn of Fair Winds} straight down during a long fall and land without taking damage.

guide.context: Horns can be found in Siren Shrines, Siren Treasuries, and shipwrecks; a crow's nest supplies enough height.

steps.text: Obtain a Horn and climb to a high point.
Jump, aim downward, and hold the blow action until you land safely.

achievements.description: Travel 5 km walking along harpoon tightropes.
achievements.summary: Walk a cumulative @mechanic{5 km} along taut ship-harpoon lines.

guide.context: A harpoon attached to a solid object becomes a tightrope; there is no in-game commendation counter.

steps.text: Fire a ship harpoon into a solid object and step onto the line.
Walk along tightropes until the cumulative distance reaches @mechanic{5 km}.

achievements.description: Use a zipline while carrying a treasure chest on your back.
achievements.summary: Ride any @mechanic{zipline} while carrying a @item{Treasure Chest} in both hands.

guide.context: Large islands and some Outposts contain fixed ziplines; the object must be a chest rather than one-handed treasure.

steps.text: Carry a two-handed Treasure Chest to a fixed zipline.
Use the zipline while still holding the chest.

achievements.description: Pledge your crew to the Burning Blade.
achievements.summary: Disable the @enemy{Burning Blade}, board the defeated ship, and vote at the Captain's cabin table to pledge your crew.

guide.context: Pledging scuttles your former ship and transfers the crew onto the Burning Blade.

steps.text: Attack the Burning Blade world-event ship until the defeated Burning Blade can be boarded.
Enter its Captain's cabin and vote to @mechanic{Pledge to the Burning Blade}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Burning Blade.
achievements.summary: Damage the @enemy{Burning Blade} world-event ship until it enters its defeated state.

guide.context: The achievement is awarded even if your crew then chooses to pledge to the defeated ship.

steps.text: Sail to the red-tornado Burning Blade world event.
Damage the Burning Blade until the Burning Blade enters its defeated state.

achievements.description: Sell a Blade of Souls.
achievements.summary: Sink or scuttle the @enemy{Burning Blade}, recover its @item{Blade of Souls}, and sell the sword.

guide.context: A pledged crew may scuttle its captured Burning Blade to generate the sword.

steps.text: Defeat and sink the Burning Blade, or scuttle the captured Burning Blade after pledging.
Recover the @item{Blade of Souls} and sell the sword to an eligible representative.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Hot Shot' Commendation.
achievements.summary: While commanding the @enemy{Burning Blade}, hit other crews' ships directly with @mechanic{Ashen Roar} three times.

guide.context: Ashen Roar fires a forward flame projectile from a lever beside the wheel and counts only against player-crewed ships.

steps.text: Pledge to the Burning Blade and approach another player crew.
Use the wheel-side lever to land @mechanic{3 direct Ashen Roar hits}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Sizzling Sinker' Commendation.
achievements.summary: As an @mechanic{Athena's Fortune Emissary}, sink a player-crewed Burning Blade @mechanic{10 times}.

guide.context: Sizzling Sinker is graded; this achievement requires Grade V rather than one qualifying sink.

steps.text: Raise an Athena's Fortune Emissary Flag and locate a player-controlled Burning Blade.
Sink the player-controlled Burning Blade and repeat until Grade V reaches @mechanic{10}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Playing the Part' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Wearing the @item{Skeleton Curse}, return a Burning Blade with at least eight Rituals completed @mechanic{10 times}.

guide.context: Each run requires the Skeleton Curse earned from Servants of the Flame Allegiance 100.

steps.text: Equip the Curse, pledge to the Burning Blade, and complete @mechanic{8 Skeleton Camps}.
Return the ship at Reaper's Hideout; repeat the full run @mechanic{10 times}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Astral Protection' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Align the constellation beneath each of the @mechanic{6 Skeleton Camps}.

guide.context: The camps are Picaroon Palms, Lagoon of Whispers, Blind Man's Lagoon, Shiver Retreat, Lookout Point, and Barnacle Cay.

steps.text: Visit each camp's underground chamber.
Complete the constellation-alignment puzzle at all six.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Defender of the Pirate's Life' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Sizzling Sinker Grade V} and @mechanic{Secretive Stash Grade V}.

guide.context: Secretive Stash requires selling a Blade of Souls carrying at least three Rituals.

steps.text: As an Athena Emissary, sink player-crewed Burning Blades @mechanic{10 times}.
Sell a Blade of Souls with at least three Rituals @mechanic{20 times}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Loyalist of the Flame' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Playing the Part Grade V} and @mechanic{Feeding the Fire Grade V}.

guide.context: Feeding the Fire records one four-Ritual streak per Burning Blade command.

steps.text: Reach a four-Ritual streak while commanding the Burning Blade on @mechanic{10 captures}.
Wearing the Skeleton Curse, return an eight-Ritual Burning Blade on @mechanic{10 runs}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Pressgang Grappler' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Use a @item{Grapple Gun} to pull an enemy player from their ship onto yours.

guide.context: The target must cross from another crew's vessel to your vessel.

steps.text: Equip a Grapple Gun and bring your ship alongside an enemy ship.
Fire at an enemy pirate so the pirate lands aboard your vessel.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Enticing Explosion' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Hit a keg-carrying skeleton with a @item{Lure Dart} @mechanic{25 times}.

guide.context: Strike the skeleton's body rather than its Gunpowder Barrel; repeated hits on one survivor can count.

steps.text: Equip the Blowpipe with Lure Darts and find a keg skeleton.
Shoot its body until the counter reaches @mechanic{25}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Revenge at Last' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Kill @mechanic{25 snakes} with @item{Poison Darts}.

guide.context: Another weapon delivering the final damage does not satisfy this Blowpipe commendation.

steps.text: Equip the Blowpipe and select Poison Darts.
Find island snakes and kill @mechanic{25} with Poison Dart damage.

achievements.description: Complete the 'The Power of Three' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Use one @item{Black Powder Dart} to ignite at least three Phantoms influenced by a @item{Lure Dart}.

guide.context: Sea Forts provide clustered Phantom waves for this combination.

steps.text: Use a Lure Dart to group at least @mechanic{3 Phantoms}.
Shoot one Black Powder Dart into the group so the blast ignites at least three Phantoms.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Comfortable Sneaker' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Travel @mechanic{1,500 metres} while crouched and undetected aboard enemy player ships or Skeleton Ships.

guide.context: Skeleton Ships are eligible, allowing solo progress without another player crew.

steps.text: Board an enemy player ship or Skeleton Ship and crouch.
Move undetected until the counter reaches @mechanic{1,500 metres}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Hidden in Plain Sight' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Travel @mechanic{450 metres} while hidden in a wearable disguise aboard an enemy player's ship.

guide.context: The default Barrel and Sailor's Chest disguises are sufficient.

steps.text: Board an enemy player's ship and equip a disguise.
Remain disguised while moving until the counter reaches @mechanic{450 metres}.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Hung Out to Dry' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Hang from the island wrecks at @loc{Discovery Ridge}, @loc{Thieves' Haven}, @loc{Galleon's Grave}, @loc{Shipwreck Bay}, and @loc{Morrow's Peak}.

guide.context: Each of the five landlocked wrecks contributes one distinct location.

steps.text: Visit each named island and locate its wrecked ship.
Crouch near the designated ledge and hang once at every wreck.

achievements.description: Complete the 'Red Alert Raider' Commendation.
achievements.summary: Load a @item{Red Signal Flare} into a trap on your ship, then have another pirate or enemy trigger the loaded trap.

guide.context: The trap must be on your own vessel and loaded before activation.

steps.text: Place a @item{Trap} on your deck and load the Trap with a Red Signal Flare.
Lure another pirate or enemy across the trap.

achievements.description: Dive to and complete a Hunter's Call Voyage.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for a Hunter's Call Voyage and complete that non-Raid Voyage.

guide.context: Hunter's Call Voyage Diving remains active for now, with a temporary Season 21 experiment expected to disable Diving sometime in September 2026. No exact switch-off day or reactivation date is set.

steps.text: Choose a Hunter's Call Voyage rather than a Raid, then select @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, complete every objective.

achievements.displayName: You're Going to Need a Bigger Bucket!
achievements.description: Attempt to extinguish the Ancient Feared Redmaw with a water bucket.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the ancient beasts route.
achievements.summary: During an @enemy{Ancient Feared Redmaw} encounter, throw a bucket of water at the Megalodon.

guide.context: The attempt is sufficient; the water cannot actually extinguish this fiery Ancient Megalodon.

steps.text: Wait for a Feared Redmaw to attack in open water.
Fill a bucket and throw the water toward Redmaw during the encounter.

achievements.description: Kill an Eel-ectric Ocean Crawler with a Trident of Dark Tides during a Barnacled Dread attack.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the ancient beasts route.
achievements.summary: During an @enemy{Ancient Barnacled Dread} attack, use a @item{Trident of Dark Tides} for the killing damage against an Eel-ectric Ocean Crawler.

guide.context: The kill and Trident damage must occur while the Barnacled Dread encounter is active.

steps.text: Keep a Trident aboard until a Barnacled Dread attacks.
While the Barnacled Dread remains active, make a @item{Trident of Dark Tides} deal the Eel-ectric Ocean Crawler's killing damage.

achievements.description: Hit Krakens, Megalodons or Ancient Megalodons using hunting spears.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the ancient beasts route.
achievements.summary: Hit Krakens, Megalodons, or Ancient Megalodons with @item{Hunting Spears} @mechanic{15 times}.

guide.context: Hunter's Call representatives sell spears for 250 gold, limited to five per crew before cooldown.

steps.text: Buy or recover Hunting Spears and retain the spears for sea-beast encounters.
Throw or cannon-fire Hunting Spears into eligible beasts until @mechanic{15 hits} register.

achievements.description: Dive to, and complete, a Voyage for The Reaper's Bones.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for a Reaper's Bones Voyage and complete that Voyage.

guide.context: Reaper's Bones Diving is still available, but the Season 21 experiment is scheduled to suspend Diving temporarily sometime in September 2026. The precise suspension and return dates are unknown.

steps.text: Choose any Reaper's Bones Voyage and select @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, complete every objective.

achievements.description: Earn the Commendation 'Bony Bodyguard'.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the reaper rule route.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Search for Ancient Secrets} without your summoned skeletons dying more than six times.

guide.context: Ancient Warriors threaten the escort skeletons, so eliminate those enemies quickly.

steps.text: Start the Reaper's Bones Search for Ancient Secrets Voyage.
Finish Search for Ancient Secrets with @mechanic{six or fewer} deaths among your Order of Bone and Blade Skeletons.

achievements.description: Earn the Commendation 'Mobile Cannoneer'.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the reaper rule route.
achievements.summary: With @item{Cannons of Rage}, defeat 150 enemies, land 5 Cursed Cannonball hits, and land 20 Firebomb hits on enemy ships.

guide.context: Skeleton and player ships count for both ship-hit tasks; emergent Fort vaults guarantee Cannons of Rage.

steps.text: Use a Cannon of Rage to defeat @mechanic{150 hostile NPCs}.
Using Cannons of Rage, hit enemy ships with @mechanic{5 Cursed Cannonballs} and @mechanic{20 Firebombs}.

achievements.description: Earn the Commendation 'Crew of Bone and Blade'.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the reaper rule route.
achievements.summary: Complete every @mechanic{Unearthed Order of Bone and Blade Commendation}.

guide.context: Buried Order skeletons appear as red-glinting bony hands on large islands.

steps.text: Unearth @mechanic{30} Order skeletons, give one Gunpowder, and give one a Cannon of Rage.
With an Order skeleton, complete @mechanic{10 quests each} in The Wilds, Ancient Isles, Shores of Plenty, and Devil's Roar.

achievements.description: Earn the Commendation 'Devious Dinghy'.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the reaper rule route.
achievements.summary: Dock both a @item{Reaper's Bones Rowboat} and an @item{Order of Bone and Blade Rowboat} to your ship.

guide.context: The Order version is black with dark maroon trim and Skeleton Runes.

steps.text: Find and dock a Reaper's Bones-liveried Rowboat.
Find and dock an Order of Bone and Blade-liveried Rowboat.

achievements.description: Dive to and complete a Smugglers' League Voyage.
achievements.sortReason: Complete before Season 21 temporarily removes Diving; Rare has not announced the exact September start day or return date.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Dive to Location} for a Smugglers' League Voyage and complete that non-Raid Voyage.

guide.context: Smugglers' League Diving is obtainable at present and will be taken offline temporarily for the Season 21 experiment sometime in September 2026. The exact cutoff and return dates have not been set.

steps.text: Choose a Smugglers' League Voyage rather than a Raid, then select @mechanic{Dive to Location}.
After resurfacing, complete every objective.

achievements.description: Complete a Smugglers' Route Run Voyage.
achievements.summary: Start and complete one @mechanic{Smugglers' Route Run} Voyage in High Seas.

guide.context: Route Runs transport volatile cargo between Smugglers' Hideouts and cannot be played in Safer Seas.

steps.text: In High Seas, select Smugglers' Route Run at the Quest Table.
Collect the assigned Smugglers' cargo and deliver the cargo along the marked route.

achievements.description: Earn 50,000 gold from The Smugglers' League.
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative @mechanic{50,000 gold} from Smugglers' League sales.

guide.context: Other Companies, including Reaper's Bones, refuse Smugglers' cargo.

steps.text: Complete Smugglers' League Voyages and preserve their cargo.
Sell Smugglers' League cargo to Smuggler representatives until payments total @mechanic{50,000 gold}.

achievements.description: Find a lost Smuggler Ship Chronicle.
achievements.summary: Find and read any one of the @mechanic{8 Smugglers' Chronicles} on beaches or in shipwrecks.

guide.context: Chronicles are readable treasure resembling Merchant Manifests; any variant qualifies.

steps.text: Search island beaches and shipwrecks for a Smugglers' Chronicle.
Hold the Chronicle and use its read interaction.

achievements.description: Defeat an Eternal Guard.
achievements.summary: Light the candles on a large-island sarcophagus and defeat the awakened @enemy{Eternal Guard}.

guide.context: Sarcophagi appear by chance on large Devil's Roar islands; a defeated Guard drops a Sanctuary key.

steps.text: Find an ancient sarcophagus and light the candles on top.
Defeat the Eternal Guard, moving away before its lethal final explosion.

achievements.description: Unlock all three Sanctuaries of the Banished.
achievements.summary: Unlock the Sanctuaries at @loc{Flame's End, Cinder Islet, and Brimstone Rock}.

guide.context: The doors are at V-19, U-14, and Y-18 respectively and each requires a key dropped by an Eternal Guard.

steps.text: Defeat Eternal Guards to obtain Sanctuary keys.
Use one key on the stone door beneath each named island.

achievements.description: Sell a Banished Ancient Treasure.
achievements.summary: Recover any @item{Banished Ancient Treasure} from a Sanctuary and sell that treasure.

guide.context: Eligible vault loot includes Chests of Banished Tribute, Skulls of Dark Banishment, Banished Merchant Logs, and Hunting Tributes.

steps.text: Unlock a Sanctuary with an Eternal Guard's key.
Take eligible Banished Ancient Treasure from the vault and sell the treasure.

achievements.description: Use a Black Powder Barrel on an Eternal Guard.
achievements.summary: Detonate a @item{Black Powder Barrel} close enough to damage an @enemy{Eternal Guard}.

guide.context: This black Smugglers' barrel is distinct from regular and Stronghold Gunpowder Barrels.

steps.text: Obtain a Black Powder Barrel from Smuggler content and awaken an Eternal Guard.
Position the Black Powder Barrel nearby and ignite the barrel so the blast damages the Eternal Guard.

achievements.description: During a Faction battle, indulge in too many tankards of grog.
achievements.summary: During an active @mechanic{Hourglass Faction battle}, repeatedly drink grog until heavily drunk.

guide.context: Drinking before matchmaking is insufficient; intoxication must occur during the battle.

steps.text: Enter a match through the Hourglass of Fate.
Refill a tankard from the ship's barrel and drink repeatedly until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: Don't Make Me Turn This Ship Around!
achievements.description: Sail 100 nautical miles with a Chest of Sorrow aboard your ship.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the misc grind route.
achievements.summary: Accumulate @mechanic{100 nautical miles} sailed while a @item{Chest of Sorrow} is aboard.

guide.context: Distance is cumulative across sessions; one chest and one uninterrupted voyage are not required.

steps.text: Recover a Chest of Sorrow and place the chest aboard your ship.
Across as many sessions as needed, keep one @item{Chest of Sorrow} on deck while sailing until the counter reaches @mechanic{100 nautical miles}.

achievements.description: Detonate a Gunpowder Barrel, Stronghold Gunpowder Barrel and Black Powder Barrel at the same time.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the misc grind route.
achievements.summary: Stack one @item{Black Powder Barrel}, one @item{Gunpowder Barrel}, and one @item{Stronghold Gunpowder Barrel}, then ignite the combined pile.

guide.context: The black Smuggler barrel is a distinct third type.

steps.text: Collect one regular keg, one bone-edged Stronghold keg, and one black Smuggler keg.
Stack the three distinct barrels together and ignite the barrel pile in one blast.

achievements.description: Create your first Custom Seas Lobby in Custom Seas.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the custom seas route.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{Custom Seas} and create your first Custom Seas lobby.

guide.context: A Custom Seas lobby supports six crews and as many as 24 players, but lobby creation does not require invitees.

steps.text: Enter Custom Seas from the main menu and choose to create a lobby.
Finish setup until the lobby is created.

achievements.description: Earn 50,000 silver by any means during a Custom Seas session.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the custom seas route.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{50,000 silver} during one Custom Seas session.

guide.context: Silver is temporary session scoring, not gold; Session Owners configure which actions award silver.

steps.text: Create or join a Custom Seas lobby with repeatable silver-scoring actions.
Start scoring and perform those actions until your total reaches @mechanic{50,000}.

achievements.description: Slay the Kraken while at Tribute Peak during a Custom Seas session.
achievements.sortReason: Keep with the custom seas route.
achievements.summary: During a Custom Seas session at @loc{Tribute Peak}, spawn and defeat a @enemy{Kraken}.

guide.context: Tribute Peak is a Legendary Location, and Session Owners can spawn world events on demand.

steps.text: Create a lobby, select Tribute Peak, and launch the session.
Use the Spawn Radial to start a Kraken encounter, then kill the Kraken at Tribute Peak.
